title: Customer Success Manager, Networks
description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
  
  
The Customer Success Manager, Networks is a key member of the post-sales organization, owning customer relationships across adoption, renewal, and expansion for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. You are the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders — including C-level executives — and this is a commercially led role rather than a networking role: you don't need to be a network engineer, but you do need enough technical fluency to understand how customers use the product, explain it credibly, and run a demo when needed.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own stakeholder relationships across IT Operations, Network Engineering, and executive leadership within your accounts.
* Run regular check-ins and quarterly/annual business reviews, communicating NetBrain's value alongside adoption progress.
* Serve as the primary point of escalation for your customers and the internal voice of the customer, looping in Support or R&D when technical depth is needed.
* Define customer-specific success metrics and track them through the account lifecycle, monitoring adoption and flagging low-utilization signals.
* Deliver business-review materials that connect product usage to the outcomes customers care about.
* Own renewal status and forecasting for your accounts, running the renewal process end to end — health check, stakeholder alignment, proposal, and close — with Sales supporting on commercial terms. Escalate at-risk accounts early with a clear recovery plan.
* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities — additional modules, seats, or use cases — applying ARR, GRR, and NRR concepts to prioritize your time. Partner with the Account Executive on expansion proposals and demonstrations.
* Log customer activity and renewal/expansion status in Salesforce (or Gainsight), relay customer feedback to Product, and nominate satisfied customers for case studies and references.

**Who You Are**

* Commercial experience owning a block of business — adoption, renewals, or onboarding — if you don't come from a networking background, plus the ability to understand the product's technical aspects well enough to explain them to customers and run a demo when needed.
* 5–6 years of overall experience, with 2+ years in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, Support, NOC, Delivery, or similar).
* Strong communication and executive presence, comfortable presenting to both technical stakeholders and C-level executives; outcome-driven, with strong problem-solving and the ability to manage multiple customers and priorities at once.
* Customer success experience in a technical product environment — infrastructure, network security, or another technically complex product — strongly preferred.
* Working understanding of enterprise networking concepts (routing/switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs) helpful but not required; a non-networking candidate with a strong commercial background will still be considered.
* Experience identifying expansion opportunities and fluency with ARR, GRR, NRR, and product adoption metrics.
* Exposure to network or infrastructure vendors (e.g., SolarWinds, Check Point, Fortinet, Juniper, Cisco) or to enterprise/Global 2000 customers preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent) — a plus, not a requirement.
* Experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or HubSpot.
* Exposure to SaaS, automation-driven, or observability platforms.

NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.
  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: people@netbraintech.com and we will be happy to assist you.
  
  
In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions.
  
  
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

description:

Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi

BE/BTech/MS/MTech/MCA/Phd in Computer Science

All applications must be accompanied with a proper cover letter, when you can join and your expected CTC.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About SmartQ:**

We go many miles beyond the F&B industry into capturing hearts and making a real difference by resolving the root cause of the business problem. At the core we strive to understand our clients' requirements through the display of empathy and provide solutions with an analytical mind that are both scalable and sustainable.

In less than a decade we have made significant strides, streamlining cafeteria operations across the globe across multiple industries through our cutting-edge technology. Armed with a global presence across 17+ countries, we believe in the principle of serving our clients and the ultimate users wholeheartedly. We are relentless at solving the key insight of “how do we make people feel the best every day!”

On the macro, we are built on 4 key pillars-great people, great food, great experience, and greater good. These pillars keep us firmly grounded to our work culture that resonates with humility and hard work, which shows in the projection of our growth trajectory.

To know more about the 5 key pillars that surround our culture check out our LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. You will be amazed to be a part of our growth story - https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewAsMember=true

**Job Description**

Are you passionate about managing and nurturing relationships with key clients/customers of a business? If your response is a resounding yes, then we are hunting for you.

As a Key Account Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to ensure client satisfaction, retention, and growth of the business. Fostering, sustainable, and profitable relationships with key clients to maximize business opportunities lies at the heart of this role. In addition, a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of the clients and products will keep you functioning a cut above the rest.

If you are a dynamic, results-oriented manager with a proven track record in steering MNCs toward unprecedented success, we invite you to seize this opportunity to make a profound impact on our global presence. Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

**Roles & Responsibilities**

• Lead the company's dynamic food service sales efforts, developing and maintaining relationships with food service institutions at all levels.

• Manage an individual expense account within budget guidelines.

• Maintain ongoing relationships with customers, driving conversations to inform them about new product developments.

• Develop quotes and proposals. Attend client meetings, food committee meetings, and other related events.

• Maintain effective, professional relationships with customers, vendors, and fellow employees.

• Administer unit operations in accordance with SmartQ standards, handling contract specifications and statutory regulations.

• Oversee the overall management of the unit, ensuring quality food services and effective partner management.

• Monitor and ensure food services meet agreed standards and specifications.

• Ensure the efficient utilization of resources, including utilities, people, and technology.

• Analyze and assist on-site/off-site partners in effective management.

• Communicate regularly with clients to stay updated on operational activities and developments.

• Complete action plans following client satisfaction surveys and audits.

• Ensure all products are correctly priced in line with client agreements and specifications.

• Complete manpower scheduling within budget, adjusting labor schedules in line with sales.

• Ensure site adherence to safety standards as per SLA.

**Qualifications:**

• Experience in the food industry required.

• Strong work ethic, integrity, and personal accountability to be a self-starter and make independent decisions.

• Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.

• Flexible and willing to take on various tasks to support team efforts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Sound knowledge and experience working with food, technology, and leveraging people.

• Results-oriented, accountable, and able to hold others accountable.

• Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment.

• Basic Food Hygiene certificate and knowledge of HSEQ standards.

• Excellent financial and application acumen.

• Self-motivated, agile, and able to adapt to a changing environment.

• Overall 6+ years of experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role.

• Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management or a related discipline.

**Message from CEO:**

We've come to realize that we're not merely in the B2B Food service industry; we're in the business of 'Capturing Hearts.' We find ourselves in a unique position to turn ordinary, mundane corporate cafeterias into places of pure delight, where individuals can freely express themselves, find inspiration, and share happiness. Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place.

title: Salesforce Success Architect
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
At Salesforce, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued. We believe that the unique perspectives and skills of diverse candidates greatly contribute to the success of our teams. As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics.
  
  
Data Cloud supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. This ensures that businesses can unify customer data across all touchpoints, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights. By powering hyper-personalized experiences and real-time decision-making, Data Cloud helps organizations maximize customer lifetime value and drive business growth.
  
  
Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. By leveraging Data Cloud, Agentforce can deliver context-aware AI automation, hyper-personalized customer interactions, and predictive insights, driving greater operational efficiency and business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be a trusted Agentforce + Data Cloud subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data Cloud relates to the success of AI
* Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, dev/ops, performance, and solution design specific to Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative Architect solutions through customization
* Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI
* Run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Agentforce + Data Cloud customers
* Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth
* Drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Your Impact**
As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers' success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Agentforce + Data Cloud's powerful data capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.
  
  
**Collaboration and Team Work**
Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 8 years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Analytics/CDP spaces
* Minimum 2 development/project implementation lifecycles of Salesforce Data Cloud/CDP + AI
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes focusing on data & integration architecture, with a focus on guiding customers through migration to and optimization of Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices
* Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive
* Ability to facilitate discussions and translate technical concepts & solutions into tangible business value and ROI for customers
* Ability to demonstrate basic understanding and stay up-to-date with emerging data-related and AI technologies
* Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues
* Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. proven behaviors in previous jobs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a consulting.implementation Partner for Data Cloud/CDP
* Experience with large data such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Storage/Big Query, Azure administration or architecture
* Experience with Customer Data platforms such as Segment, Tealium, Adobe Experience Platform, Amperity, Treasure Data, Twilio Segment, Realtio, etc
* Experience implementing Salesforce Clouds, Multi cloud scenarios - Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce
* Familiar with at least one of the Salesforce Architecture Domains: Integration, Access and Identity Management, Data Architecture, Sharing and Visibility, Declarative and APEX Development
* Experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, .Net, SQL

**Note:**
This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.
  
  
**Shifts -**
Candidate should be comfortable working in AMER shifts (6:30 PM - 3:30 AM) as well.
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Account Manager – US Staffing

Shift: 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST

Work Mode: On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 7–10 years

Salary: ₹8–11 LPA + attractive incentives

Shift: 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST

Openings: 1

Joining: Immediate joiners preferred

Email: talent@kkbtalentnetwork.com

JOB TITLE

Account Manager – US Staffing

HIRING PARTNER

KKB Talent Network

WORKPLACE TYPE

On-site

LOCATION

Please enter the confirmed job location in LinkedIn.

EMPLOYMENT TYPE

Full-time

SENIORITY LEVEL

Mid-Senior level

JOB FUNCTION

Sales, Business Development

INDUSTRY

Staffing and Recruiting, IT Services and IT Consulting

We are hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage and grow client and vendor relationships within the US Staffing business. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in both Business Development and US IT Account Management, along with a strong understanding of the end-to-end US Staffing lifecycle.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Account Manager will be responsible for managing client accounts, strengthening business relationships, coordinating staffing requirements, facilitating commercial discussions, and supporting successful placements.

Candidates must have dedicated experience in both Business Development (BDM) and US IT Account Management, with the ability to manage client expectations, coordinate with vendors and recruitment teams, and support account growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build and maintain strong relationships with employers, clients, and staffing vendors.

• Manage accounts throughout the staffing lifecycle, from requirement intake and candidate coordination to offer closure and ongoing relationship management.

• Understand client hiring requirements and coordinate with recruitment teams to support timely candidate submissions.

• Facilitate offer negotiations and align client and candidate expectations.

• Generate and maintain a high-quality candidate pipeline within agreed turnaround times.

• Coordinate with recruitment, sales, and vendor management stakeholders to support successful placements.

• Manage client and vendor communication and maintain productive professional relationships.

• Support account development through effective relationship management and business development activities.

• Apply working knowledge of US consultant engagement models, including W-2, Corp-to-Corp (C2C), and 1099 arrangements.

• Work with US staffing platforms, including Dice, Monster, Indeed, and CareerBuilder.

• Support vendor management processes and coordinate effectively with clients, vendors, and consultants.

• Work independently in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment and contribute to business priorities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

• 7–10 years of hands-on experience in US Staffing.

• Mandatory experience in both Business Development (BDM) and US IT Account Management.

• Strong understanding of the end-to-end US Staffing lifecycle and account management practices.

• Practical experience in client relationship management, vendor coordination, and staffing operations.

• Working knowledge of W-2, C2C, and 1099 consultant engagement models.

• Experience with Dice, Monster, Indeed, CareerBuilder, and vendor management processes.

• Strong communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a target-oriented environment.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Experience in both Business Development and US IT Account Management is mandatory.

Candidates with a combined Bench Sales and US IT Recruitment background will not be considered.

Candidates with a combined Non-IT and US IT Recruitment background will not be considered.

Immediate joiners will be preferred.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• Annual CTC: ₹8–11 LPA, depending on experience and suitability.

• Attractive incentives.

• Leave encashment.

• Bonus, subject to applicable company policies.

• Opportunity to manage client relationships and contribute to account growth within the US Staffing business.

WORKING CONDITIONS

• Work Arrangement: On-site.

• Shift Timing: 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST.

• Transportation: Cab facility is not provided.

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates with relevant experience in both BDM and US IT Account Management are encouraged to apply or
Email us at talent@kkbtalentnetwork.com

Please share your updated CV at talent@kkbtalentnetwork.com.

Email Subject: Account Manager – US Staffing

Immediate joiners with relevant experience will be preferred.

Open Positions: 1

Skills to add

US Staffing, Account Management, US IT Staffing, Business Development, BDM, Client Management, Vendor Management, IT Recruitment, W2, C2C, 1099, Dice, Monster, Indeed, CareerBuilder, Hot Jobs, Negotiation, Stakeholder Management

title: Oracle HCM Service Manager
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Who you are:**
You are an experienced service management professional with hands-on experience supporting enterprise People technology services. You understand the importance of stable, secure, and user-centred People services across employee lifecycle processes, talent, recruitment, learning, performance, workforce management, reporting, integrations, and operational support. You are customer centric, commercially aware, and confident operating in a complex global environment. You take ownership of incident restoration, service level performance, change coordination, problem management, service communications, stakeholder alignment, vendor performance, and continuous service improvement for People Function services.
  
  
**What You’ll Own:**

* Act as the key point of contact for People Function service support across People stakeholders, HR operations, business process owners, Enterprise Applications teams, Global Technology Services & Operations, support teams, and internal/external service providers.
* Own all aspects of People Function service management, including incident, change, problem, knowledge management, service communications, service creation, transition, and operation.
* Ensure service lines deliver reliable customer service, incident restoration, service request fulfilment, and service level agreement performance for People processes, platforms, and integrations.
* Monitor, report, and improve the availability and performance of end-to-end People Function services, including business-critical HR processes and downstream integrations.
* Develop People Function standard operating procedures and knowledge-based articles for handover to Level 1 and Level 2 support teams.
* Identify, prioritise, and implement People Function service improvements in collaboration with People stakeholders, technology, operations, and supplier teams.

**Role accountabilities:**
**Service Management:**

* Coordinate incident, problem, service request, change, knowledge management, and service communication activities for People Function services.
* Work with Global Technology Services & Operations and service operations teams to manage incident and problem response, resolution, and service requests with a strong focus on end-user and Key Business User satisfaction.
* Manage service escalations by establishing clear escalation paths, coordinating timely stakeholder updates, driving issue ownership across internal and external teams, and ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution of business-impacting People Function service issues.
* Ensure relevant service lines deliver reliable support for People processes, platforms, integrations, access-related issues, service changes, and operational communications.
* Manage operational KPIs for BAU deliveries, including shift rota coverage, continuity, handover, responsiveness, and adherence to agreed service performance measures across People Function service operations.
* Report on People Function service availability, performance, response and resolution times, backlog status, customer satisfaction, and service improvement opportunities.

**Service Alignment & Continuous Improvement:**

* Assess People Function service or regional change requests and coordinate implementation, testing, deployment, and communication across People stakeholders, business users, and service teams.
* Coordinate People Function deployments and releases across Enterprise Applications to ensure controlled implementation, minimal service disruption, and effective release communications.
* Coordinate problem management by ensuring relevant People process owners, internal suppliers, external suppliers, operations, integrations, security, and testing teams are engaged and informed.
* Own service creation and transition activities for People Function capabilities, ensuring changes to systems, integrations, roles, and business processes are communicated back to Global Technology Services & Operations.
* Define and implement the support model for onboarding new HCM technology solutions, including service ownership, support tiers, operational processes, knowledge transfer, handover requirements, service readiness, and integration into BAU support operations.
* Cooperate with other domain service managers to ensure service integration across People services and wider enterprise application, reporting, and integration services.
* Work with stakeholders to continually improve People Function services and ensure the service offering meets current and future People and business needs.

**Vendor Management & Collaboration:**

* Work closely with People Function support teams, process owners, integration teams, security teams, reporting teams, and external service providers to ensure reliable end-to-end service delivery.
* Manage and steer third-party performance to support People Function service performance, agreed service levels, operational outcomes, and end-user experience.
* Collaborate proactively with Domain BPOs, BPEs, KBUs, end users, Global Engagement & Operations domain teams, Enterprise Applications teams, and Global Technology Services & Operations to develop, implement, maintain, and improve People Function services.

**Key Shared Accountabilities:**

* Partner with other Enterprise Applications lanes, People product teams, HR operations teams, and domain service teams to exceed business expectations.
* Support portfolio service management across People and related enterprise application domains, including major incident management with Global Technology Services & Operations where People services or integrations are impacted.
* Contribute to technical solution decisions with the Global Continuous Improvements lane for People Function service improvements.
* Coordinate update, release, and regression testing with the Enterprise Applications Test Manager, People product leads, process owners, and Key Business Users.
* Support People Function integrations with Global System Integrations teams, including upstream and downstream dependencies across payroll, identity, reporting, finance, and other enterprise platforms.
* Develop People Function SOPs and knowledge-based articles with Global Delivery Enablement and coordinate service disruption announcements and end-user communications.

**Decision rights:**

* Owns: Service design, transition, and operation within the People Function service portfolio.
* Owns: Contributing to customer satisfaction through effective People Function service management, vendor management, stakeholder engagement, and service communications.
* Influences: Business decisions on People Function service creation, service transition, process changes, and continuous service improvements.
* Influences: Production deployments that pose significant security, data, operational, employee experience, or business disruption risks.

**The ideal candidate should:**

* Have a minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience in service management and/or support for major ERP, HR, People, or enterprise business technology platforms.
* Demonstrate strong customer-centricity and a proven track record of achieving service excellence in a complex global organisation with People, HR, business, technology, and supplier stakeholders.
* Have practical experience managing incidents, problems, changes, service requests, knowledge articles, service communications, service transition, and continuous improvement across People Function services.
* Understand the operational importance of People processes, employee data, security/access, integrations, reporting, releases, and business continuity.
* Be able to maintain positive stakeholder relationships and work effectively with external resources and third-party service providers.
* Use service metrics such as end-user and Key Business User NPS, incident/problem/service request response and resolution times, backlog management, availability, CSAT, and OLA performance to drive improvement.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience with service management and/or support for major ERP, HR, People, or enterprise business technology systems.
* Experience supporting People or HR business processes, platforms, integrations, reporting, access/security processes, service operations, or enterprise application support.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, service coordination, vendor management, service reporting, and continuous improvement skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with People Function technology services such as core HR, talent, recruitment, learning, performance, compensation, absence, time, payroll integrations, workforce structures, security, analytics, reporting, or employee experience platforms.
* Service management experience with Oracle HCM and/or Oracle ERP platforms would be preferred, particularly in supporting enterprise application operations, integrations, releases, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
* Experience operating in or alongside ITIL-based service management processes, including incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.
* Experience managing third-party service providers and support partners against People Function service expectations, operational measures, and end-to-end service performance.
* Experience supporting service creation, transition, major incident management, service reporting, release testing, regression testing, and continuous improvement plans.
* Relevant service management, ITIL, HR technology, enterprise applications, or vendor management certification would be advantageous.

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people.

description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed product leader to join us as a leader for the Dynamic Andon Response Team (DART) org within Customer Service. You will lead our team of program managers, product managers, quality managers and business analysts who dig deep into peer-to-peer consultation and customer escalations, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to DART Usage. Your teams will own the roadmap of DART strategic initiatives primarily focused on technical solutions to eliminate wasteful usage for DART and enhance CX for DART escalations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from customers, DART specialists and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.
  
  
You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
  
  
Your teams will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.
  
  
**This Is The Right Role For You If**

* You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
* You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
* You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
* You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
* You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.
* Lead multiple teams to improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of customer escalations and associate consult contacts.
* Own the DART Usage Rate improvement vision and create scalable mechanisms to drive organizational change.
* Establish data-driven approaches to surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.
* Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues causing escalations through high-quality analytics and communication.
* Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.
* Coach and develop high-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

About 79th East

79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad-based investment services firm, an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-364145) and distributor of Portfolio Management Services (PMS Registration No. APRN10260).

The Role

We are looking for a Relationship Manager to be the primary point of contact for clients, with strong knowledge of Mutual Funds, PMS and Listed Equity. The role covers client relationship management, portfolio reviews, rebalancing, referrals, distribution/franchise development and investor-education initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and manage relationships across HNI, affluent, professional, business-owner and NRI segments, including referrals from existing clients.

• Manage an assigned client book through regular reviews, prompt service and proactive communication.

• Conduct risk profiling and suitability documentation, clearly explaining risks, costs, lock-ins, taxation and exit terms.

• Conduct portfolio reviews and support appropriate rebalancing of Mutual Funds and Stocks based on client objectives, risk profile and approved recommendations.

• Explain Mutual Funds, PMS and Equity Investments, including structure, the ₹50 lakh PMS minimum, fees, taxation, risks and transparency.

• Acquire and develop referral relationships and support franchise/distribution opportunities in line with company policies and approved processes.

• Plan and conduct investor-education webinars and seminars, coordinating with AMCs and using approved firm/AMC material.

title: Manager III, Program Mgmt , Payment Risk
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraudulent purchases among millions of e-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where customers can safely transact online? What kinds of solutions and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction?
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager who is passionate about process and systemic improvement initiatives in the Payments risk space to reduce defects and improve experience for our customers. The PM will be responsible to build out mechanisms to help improve CX and integrate the techniques into Payment Risk business unit. The PM will leverage Customer data via Executive Escalations to help us understand and respond to key challenges and successes of our programs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Project Management**

* Gather requirements, document functional specifications, identify stakeholders and process partners, identify defects and gaps, contribute cross-functional solutions, assess and manage risks, measure and report on progress, anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and make tradeoffs.
* Conduct customer research, identify gaps in product/experience offering, and design solutions that address unmet customer needs
* Drive product awareness and adoption: Identify opportunities and support program improvements.

**Reporting**

* Deliver progress of multiple projects providing regular updates to senior leadership.
* Monitor and report risks with actionable insights; anticipate and resolve roadblocks.
* Provide strategic recommendations to leadership to proactively address systemic issues.

**Results & Accountability**

* Challenge assumptions of why a process or service failed; ask right questions to get to the root of the problem.
* Strong commitment towards goals and outcomes and to ensure completion within established time frames.
* Clears blockers, escalates appropriately

**Collaboration And Team Management**

* Manage partner relations, performance and customer experience, set objectives and success criteria, and drive towards operational excellence.
* Partners with global process owners, Site leaders, Operation managers in identifying, defining and executing various process improvement projects
* Collaborate to refine and improve the workflow between teams, ensuring timelines are met on all sides.

In this role you will work closely with Product, Operations, Tech, Machine learning, Engineering and Data analysts to streamline development of initiatives to solve for experience for our buyers, at scale- ultimately to help buyers shop safely at Amazon. You will manage a team of Program managers and Resolution managers to deliver on goals.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 5+ years of team management experience
* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

* Experience delivering cross functional projects

title: Area Service Manager
description:
**Job Overview**
The position is responsible for allocating jobs and supervising field-based engineers within a designated region to ensure timely service delivery, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency. The role focuses on improving the technical capability and productivity of engineers, coordinating service activities through CRM/FSM, managing customer and spare-part related follow-ups, and supporting the State Head in implementing systems, field service processes, and project execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities (List All)**

* Allocate breakdown, preventive maintenance, installation, and project jobs to field engineers in a timely manner
* Monitor and download pending complaints from FSM/ERP systems at regular intervals
* Update complaint status, engineer feedback, and service activities in CRM/FSM and customer portals
* Coordinate with stores for timely dispatch and reconciliation of required spares
* Track and update spares requirements based on field engineer feedback from retail outlets
* Follow up with engineers for timely submission of service reports, especially for billable and chargeable jobs
* Send quotations to customers for chargeable jobs and attach customer approvals in FSM
* Respond to customer calls and emails and ensure effective issue resolution
* Ensure timely execution of DU installation, preventive maintenance, and project-related jobs
* Support engineers during the introduction of new equipment, systems, or business activities
* Report urgent concerns, abnormal field activities, and operational risks to the State Head/Zonal Head
* Ensure balanced workload distribution across engineers by geography, retail outlet, complaint volume, and nozzle count
* Verify availability of toolkits, PPE, and other essential field resources for engineers
* Prepare and manage monthly schedules for engineers’ spares reconciliation
* Coordinate with the commercial team for accurate planning of preventive maintenance and breakdown jobs to improve productivity
* Follow up for return of defective spares to the service center on a weekly basis
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, service standards, and Health & Safety policies
* Maintain operational reports and participate in field service system/process implementation with the State Head

****Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack**
***(List all)*****
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree / diploma in Electrical/Electronics
* Minimum 5 years of field service experience
* Good working knowledge of ERP/FSM/CRM systems
* Strong computer proficiency in MS Word and MS Excel
* Good coordination, planning, and execution skills
* Ability to manage field operations and supervise service engineers
* Strong communication skills for customer, internal team, and stakeholder coordination
* Knowledge of service processes, spare management, and chargeable job handling
* Understanding of Health & Safety requirements in field operations
* Ability to work under pressure and ensure SLA-driven execution

**Preferable**

* Experience in managing field-based teams
* Exposure to oil & gas, retail outlet, or petroleum equipment service operations
* Familiarity with preventive maintenance planning and breakdown service management
* Experience in handling customer escalations and service reporting systems
* Working knowledge of workload planning and field productivity management

title: IT&D Senior Manager, Service Delivery
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
The IT&D Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end-to-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.
  
  
This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high-quality services.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Service Accountability

Own the end-to-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
  
  
Act as the business-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.Ownership of the service experience, including NPS for all applications in your capability stream.
  
  
Own service & vendor accountability, governance, and performance reviews against defined SLAs and KPIs.
  
  

* Supplier & SIAM-Oriented Service Orchestration

Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support. Operate as part of a SIAM-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
  
  

* Service Performance & Governance

Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
  
  
Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:
  
  
Drive performance interventions where services fall below agreed standards.
  
  

* Stakeholder & Business Relationship Management

Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
  
  
Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
  
  
Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions for applications in your capability stream using clear, business focused language.
  
  

* Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management

Collaborate with IT Service Management to ensure robust incident and major incident management for applications in your capability stream across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
  
  
Sponsor or lead Major Incident Management, ensuring rapid restoration and effective business communication for applications in your capability stream.
  
  
Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered to improve application services in your capability stream.
  
  
Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.
  
  

* Change, Release & Service Transition Oversight

Govern supplier-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
  
  
Ensure all changes meet quality, security, and compliance requirements.
  
  
Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes to applications in your capability stream, including: Minimise early-life failures and production issues post-go-live.
  
  

* Operational Risk, Resilience & Compliance

Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
  
  
Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  
  
Drive improvements in monitoring, resilience, and recovery capabilities to protect critical business processes.
  
  

* Continual Improvement, Automation & Efficiency

Own and execute a continual service improvement roadmap for the capability stream.
  
  
Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives. Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:
  
  
Champion modern service management practices and tooling (e.g. ServiceNow).
  
  

* Financial & Contractual Management (Run Services)

Manage run-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
  
  
Ensure cost transparency and value-for-money from service providers.
  
  
Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.
  
  
The experience we're looking for
  
  
Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM-based environment owning a large applications portfolio as an IT service owner.
  
  
Proven experience working within a complex, fast-paced global FMCG, retail, or manufacturing sector preferred.
  
  
Strong expertise in ITIL-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
  
  
Demonstrated success managing multiple large-scale global IT outsourcing partners, managed service contracts and end-to-end service outcomes.
  
  
Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
  
  
Experience supporting large-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
  
  
Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
  
  
Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
  
  
The skills for success
  
  
Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Delivery Director
description:
Position -
**Delivery Director**

Experience -
**15 - 20 Years**

Location -
**Hyderabad, India**

Portfolio -
**~$03M to ~$20M Revenue | Multi-account, cross-service delivery**

**JOB OVERVIEW**

As a DU Leader, you will serve as the single point of accountability for delivery success across a portfolio of client accounts managed from Hyderabad. Unlike a service-line-aligned role, this position spans the full breadth of Jade Global's service portfolio — including Business Applications (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), Salesforce, Workday, Analytics, Integration, Infrastructure, and AI & Digital Engineering. You will own delivery execution, customer satisfaction, governance, team leadership, and commercial performance across all services within your assigned accounts.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Engagement & Satisfaction**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for assigned accounts; build trusted relationships with key client stakeholders
* Manage customer cadence including weekly status reviews (WSRs), monthly delivery reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
* Own OSAT/CSAT metrics and proactively manage feedback and improvement actions across the portfolio

**Delivery Management**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery across all Jade service lines within assigned accounts — projects, managed services, and enhancement requests
* Ensure delivery is in alignment with contracted scope, SLAs, and KPIs across a multi-service environment
* Manage RAID logs, resource planning, and issue escalations to ensure seamless delivery execution

**People Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the offshore delivery team in Hyderabad across all service lines within the DU
* Own hiring, performance management, and career development — driving retention and engagement below industry attrition benchmarks
* Manage team capacity, bench pipeline, and utilization to meet portfolio delivery demands

**Governance, Reporting & Commercial Performance**

* Drive delivery governance through structured reporting, dashboards, and executive updates
* Monitor and own performance metrics, financial health (margins, revenue realization), and resource utilization
* Ensure delivery leader overhead is priced and recovered within engagement and managed services models

**Growth & Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Solution Leads, Practice Heads, and onsite-offshore delivery teams
* Identify and develop opportunities for account growth, contract renewals, cross-sell, and transformation initiatives
* Champion AI tool adoption across the DU; track and report AI revenue contribution within managed accounts

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; MBA preferred
* 15+ years of experience in IT services delivery, including 5+ years in a senior delivery leadership or client-facing delivery management role
* Breadth of exposure across two or more Jade service areas (e.g. Business Applications, Analytics, Integration, Infrastructure, Salesforce, Workday)
* Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder client portfolios with distributed onsite-offshore teams
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to own P&L, manage margins, and identify growth opportunities
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presence
* Experience with delivery governance tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent
* Certifications: PMP, ITIL, or equivalent preferred

**Nice to Have**

* Domain experience in Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Finance industries
* Experience with Agile/DevOps models and AI-led delivery acceleration

**WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE**

* Clients proactively want to renew and expand — delivery consistently meets or exceeds expectations across all service lines.
* No delivery surprises — risks are flagged and resolved before they reach the client.
* OSAT and gross margins are consistently at or above target across the portfolio.
* The team is engaged, growing, and proud of the work they deliver — attrition is below industry benchmarks.

**WHY JOIN US**

You should join us if you are interested in shaping an organization that is on a rapid growth path. Jade is an employee-friendly, open, and transparent workplace. You will have the opportunity to bring ideas and suggestions and have them implemented. This is a senior leadership role and a key strategic position within the company, allowing you to make a significant impact on our growth and the success of our clients.

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
  
  
Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
  
  
The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day-to-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
  
  
**Day-to-day Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day-to-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions

**Essential Traits**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**About Kroll**
Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
  
  
In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com
  
  
*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit*

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Interactly.ai**

Interactly.ai is transforming healthcare operations with AI-powered automation across scheduling, lab follow-ups, eligibility checks, prior authorization, insurance verification, and more. Our multimodal AI agents work across voice, email, chat, fax, and EHR integrations, improving patient access, reducing staff burden, and accelerating care delivery. We already serve 2,000+ physicians and healthcare providers, delivering measurable outcomes such as 20–30% fewer no-shows and thousands of staff hours saved.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our US healthcare customers - medical groups, specialty practices, and health systems. You will make sure our AI agents go live smoothly, get adopted by front-office and revenue cycle teams, and deliver outcomes customers can see in their numbers. Based in Hyderabad and working closely with our Head of Customer Success and US go-to-market team, you will be the person our customers trust to make Interactly.ai work for them, and the person our product team relies on to understand what customers actually need.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of US healthcare accounts, from post-signature handoff through renewal.
* Partner with implementation, solutions, and engineering to configure workflows and EHR/PMS integrations, and launch on schedule.
* Agree on success metrics with each customer at kickoff, track adoption, automation rates, no-show reduction, staff hours saved, lead QBRs and executive reviews.
* Monitor account health, flag churn risk early, own renewals, and identify expansion into new workflows (eligibility, prior authorization, lab follow-ups) with the sales team.
* Own customer issues end to end across support, engineering, and leadership until they are resolved and the customer is confident again.
* Bring structured, prioritized feedback to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Help define CS processes, health scoring, onboarding templates, and documentation as the function scales.

**Qualifications**

* Experience with 8–10 years of total experience, with a substantial portion in customer success, account management, or client delivery. Strong profiles with 6+ years will be considered.
* Minimum 2 years in US healthcare (provider, payer, RCM, or health-tech), ideally within the last 2–3 years.
* B2B SaaS background with direct US client exposure, comfortable running calls and business reviews with practice managers, operations leaders, and executives.
* Working knowledge of US healthcare workflows such as scheduling and patient access, eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorization, and revenue cycle.
* Comfortable building reports and dashboards, working in Excel/Sheets and a CRM, and turning data into a clear value story.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering. An MBA is a plus, not a requirement.
* Location: Hyderabad-based or willing to relocate, able to work with overlap with US time zones.
* Availability: Able to join within 2 weeks. Immediate joiners will be prioritized.

**Bonus / Preferred Skills (not mandatory)**

* Hands-on exposure to EHR/PMS platforms such as Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or NextGen.
* Experience with AI, automation, or conversational/voice products.
* Familiarity with HIPAA and compliance considerations in customer deployments.
* Experience at an early-stage company or helping build a CS function from scratch.

**Interview Process**

Three rounds, designed to move quickly:

1. Head of Customer Success - customer success approach, account ownership, and US client experience.
2. India Site Leader - collaboration, ownership, and fit with the Hyderabad team.
3. CEO - final conversation on vision, values, and long-term fit.

The Assistant Manager – Client Partnerships will play a key role in strengthening the analytical, reporting, and business development support backbone of the Client Partnerships function. The incumbent will be expected to operate with a high degree of accuracy, ownership, and proactivity, ensuring that leadership has timely, error-free, and consistent information to support the firm's growth objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* Perform recurring and ad-hoc analyses of client portfolio dynamics, including new client acquisition, churn/attrition, downsizes, expansions, and client origination attribution to generate actionable insights for leadership.
* Monitor pipeline health on an ongoing basis and proactively escalate risks such as stalled opportunities, weakening early-stage activity, or declining conversion trends, along with supporting analysis and recommendations.

* Support senior stakeholders in developing pitch decks, proposals, and RFP responses for both new business and account-farming initiatives, while tracking opportunities and coordinating outreach across the BD pipeline.
* Maintain and periodically refresh standard business development collateral, with particular emphasis on AI-embedded solution offerings in collaboration with vertical heads, ensuring consistency of messaging and a unified narrative across all BD materials in alignment with ED+ stakeholders.
* Prepare periodic reports, dashboards, and meeting decks covering sales activity, pipeline progression, lead generation, and other key business development metrics.
* Maintain the CRM system (DealCloud) with real-time accuracy, including opportunity status, lead management activity, and pipeline data integrity, ensuring it serves as a reliable single source of truth for leadership.
* Support CP leadership in shaping and executing the function's strategic roadmap, and lead process improvement initiatives that enhance the efficiency, responsiveness, and scalability of the Client Partnerships function.
* Leverage AI tools to automate recurring and daily tasks, including reporting, research synthesis, and collateral updates.
* Collaborate with CP leadership, ED+ stakeholders, and delivery/functional teams to ensure alignment of priorities, timelines, and messaging, while ensuring all deliverables shared with senior stakeholders are accurate, timely, and error-free.

* Minimum 4–5 years of experience in client partnerships, business development, account management, or a related field, preferably within a Professional Services firm or a mid-size/multinational environment.
* Strong stakeholder coordination and relationship management skills, with the ability to build credibility and work effectively with senior internal stakeholders across leadership, delivery, and functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience contributing to presentations, proposals, and business development materials.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret market and pipeline data and convert insights into practical, actionable recommendations.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, preferably DealCloud, and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; familiarity with AI productivity tools is a strong advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with strong attention to detail, ownership, and a track record of delivering accurate, executive-ready output under deadlines.
* Experience working with global teams and comfort operating across different markets and cultural contexts.
* A proactive, collaborative mindset with a strong interest in contributing to business growth and client success i.e., anticipates issues, flags risks early, and drives tasks to closure without follow-up.

**Why Explore a Career at Accordion:**

**A Culture of Impact & Excellence**

* **A culture of merit & recognition:**
  Thrive in a meritocratic, high-growth environment with semi-annual performance and promotion cycles.
* **Multi - dimensional exposure**
  : Navigate complex, high stakes workstreams across diverse industries and domains. At Accordion, you will engage with varied intellectual challenges that keep your perspective sharp, and your curiosity fuelled.
* **Entrepreneurial environment:**
  Exercise the intellectual freedom to make definitive decisions and the autonomy to own their outcomes. We reward initiative, encouraging you to expand your influence and assume larger responsibilities.
* **Collaborative vitality**
  : Experience a non-bureaucratic, high-energy culture alongside high-calibre peers. Our environment is designed to challenge your thinking and accelerate your growth through shared expertise and collective ambition.

**Our Commitment to Your Well-being**

We believe that our collective success is rooted in the personal well-being and growth of our people. We have curated a suite of benefits designed to support you and your family’s health, celebrate your milestones, and empower your professional journey.

* **Comprehensive health & security:**
  We provide fully covered Health and Group Term Life Insurance for you, with health insurance coverage extending to your immediate family.
* **Care on your terms:**
