* **Integrated family support:**
  We support working parents with a fully sponsored, premium on-site Day Care facility.
* **Empowering leave structures:**
  Our robust leave policy is an intentional commitment to work-life integration, featuring dedicated maternity and parental support designed to help new parents through life’s major transitions.
* **A culture of recognition:**
  We believe every breakthrough deserves an audience. Through our dedicated rewards platform, we pause to celebrate both your professional triumphs and your most meaningful personal milestones.
* **Architecting your growth:**
  Thrive in a positive & transparent environment designed for the continuous evolution of your craft. We provide the infrastructure - through learning programs and engagement initiatives - to bridge the gap between your personal aspirations and professional mastery.

description:

Define and execute the growth roadmap for the Salesforce delivery practice — target offerings (Revenue Cloud/CPQ & Billing, Sales & Service Cloud, Agentforce, Data Cloud, integrations), capability build-out, partner alignment with Salesforce, and positioning against market demand.

· Own the practice P&L: revenue targets, gross margin, utilisation, pyramid mix, rate card discipline, and forecasting accuracy across the global delivery organisation.

· Act as the senior solution authority in pre-sales — qualify opportunities with Sales and Account Management, shape solution architecture and delivery approach, govern effort estimates, review SOWs and pricing, and present to C-level stakeholders in competitive pursuits.

Agile/Scrum ways of working, architecture and code review gates, CPQ/Billing testing and data migration playbooks, DevOps and release governance, and portfolio-level risk registers with real mitigation plans.

·Lead the AI-led delivery agenda — embed Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and AI-assisted engineering into estimation, build, testing and support, and evangelise measurable adoption benefits internally and with clients.

·Build reusable IP — accelerators, Quote-to-Cash reference architectures, industry solution frameworks, estimation models and best-practice templates — that shorten delivery cycles and lift margin.

Required Qualification :

·15+ years in IT consulting and professional services, with at least 10 years leading work in the Salesforce ecosystem.

·5+ years in a senior practice leadership role (VP, Senior Director or Partner level) at a systems integrator or technology consulting firm.

·Deep functional and technical command of Salesforce — Revenue Cloud / CPQ & Billing, Sales and Service Cloud, and emerging Agentforce/AI capabilities — with the credibility to challenge an architecture in a client room.

·Demonstrated P&L ownership: multi-million dollar revenue responsibility, margin and utilisation management, and a track record of winning enterprise-scale deals.

·Hands-on experience running and optimising global delivery models across onshore, nearshore and offshore teams, including governance, staffing pyramids and quality assurance.

·Strong pre-sales muscle — solution shaping, effort estimation, SOW construction, commercial structuring and executive-level pitching.

·Exceptional executive presence: clear, persuasive communication and negotiation with CIOs, CROs, CFOs and their leadership teams.

·Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.

·Active Salesforce certifications — Application Architect, System Architect, Revenue Cloud / CPQ Specialist, or senior cloud consultant credentials. Experience delivering multi-cloud and multi-platform programmes, including Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing and finance systems. Prior experience building a practice from a small team into a large, multi-geography delivery organisation. Exposure to managed services / AMS commercial models alongside project-based delivery.

Eligibility / Qualification

15+ years total professional experience with 10+ years directly relevant to the Salesforce ecosystem, including 5+ years in senior practice or delivery leadership at a systems integrator. Bachelor's degree required; MBA and active Salesforce architect-level certifications strongly preferred. Must be comfortable operating across global time zones and travelling for client engagements as needed.

description:

**Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in sales operations, management consulting, business operations, or equivalent strategy and operations experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.

* MBA or Master's degree in a related field or CSCMP certification.
* Operations Six Sigma, COPC and LEAN certification (or other relevant operations coursework).
* Experience of AI/ML tools or agentic solutions.
* Expertise in data and insights.
* Knowledge of SQL and analytics.

**About the job**
gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner. In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration and more).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and own future-proof quality frameworks to measure end-to-end customer journeys. Establish robust evaluation criteria for the Customer Experience (CX) of agentic solutions, track scalable successes, root-cause complex systemic issues, and ensure broad business impact.
* Advocate an automation-first strategy by actively developing and deploying tools using AI. Apply a deep understanding of automation to transform quality control, operations, and the day-to-day management of activities.
* Act as a senior advisor and strategic partner in a highly matrixed, cross-functional, and global environment, driving alignment across senior leadership, engineering, and operational teams.
* Drive proactive CX improvements by identifying systemic/outlier issues across both human and agentic workflows, translating complex data into strategic insights that heavily influence product development and operational strategies.
* Evaluate and optimize the application of agentic solutions within operations, ensuring they deliver exceptional customer experiences.

title: CRM Manager | ZOHO & HUBSPOT
description:
**Company Description**
AR GLOBAL HUB is a global education consultancy that supports students in achieving their aspirations of studying abroad in the UK, Canada, and other leading destinations. The organization specializes in university admissions, visa guidance, IELTS coaching, and personalized counseling tailored to each student’s goals. With a mission to simplify international education, AR GLOBAL HUB focuses on making complex processes clear and manageable. The team is committed to empowering students with the right information, resources, and opportunities to succeed in their academic journeys.

**Role Description**
The CRM Manager | ZOHO & HUBSPOT will oversee the setup, optimization, and daily management of CRM systems to support student recruitment and counseling operations. In this full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, the individual will manage contact databases, create and monitor pipelines, segment leads, and design workflows and automation within Zoho and HubSpot. The role involves collaborating with sales and counseling teams to track interactions, manage follow-ups, and improve conversion rates, as well as generating reports and dashboards to inform decision-making. The CRM Manager will also ensure data quality, maintain compliance with relevant policies, provide user training and support, and continuously refine CRM processes to enhance efficiency and student experience.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to interpret CRM data, generate insights, and create performance reports and dashboards.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with sales, counseling, and management teams and provide clear CRM guidance.
* Sales and market segmentation skills to manage pipelines, segment leads, and support targeted outreach and conversion strategies.
* Project management skills to plan, implement, and optimize CRM workflows, automation, and system enhancements.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM and HubSpot, including configuration, integrations, and user administration.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, data security, and compliance with organizational policies.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in an on-site setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, or a related field; experience in education consultancy or CRM management is an advantage.

title: Startup Account Manager - Greenfield, India Startups Team
description:
**Description**
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly two decades of experience, gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.
  
  
AWS continues to rapidly grow and we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth with well-funded and high-potential startups. In this fast-moving business, the core responsibility is to ensure that new and high-potential startups choose AWS as their cloud platform to transform and accelerate their business. We work backwards from the customer and partner with technical team members, business development, and stakeholders to lead scaled Go-to-Market strategies, accelerate adoption and drive customer success.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a passion to work with innovators and new technologies, has a strong sales background, and has the technical aptitude to learn and discuss the latest technologies, such as generative AI, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data services, and sustainable computing. This is a fast-paced role. We work at the speed of startup founders, are able to engage personas from developers to technical founders and CXOs. You will work along side Solution Architects and Product Specialists, Inside Sales, Business Development, and technology and services partners. You will be a self-starter, travel for in-person meetings, and attend events. You will develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets and measurable business objectives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
* Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
* Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
* Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
* Expect moderate travel.

**About The Team**
About the team
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 7+ years of technology sales experience
* Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
* Experience selling cloud/AI solutions to Startups

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Indepth understanding on Startup & VC Ecosystem in India
* Startup Founder/ Startup operating experience in business development, venture capital, or in leadership roles
* Extensive skills in leveraging tools and technology to increase efficiency in your day-to-day activities
* Demonstrated ability to own projects and events from design to execution

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- AWS India - Telangana

title: Key Accounts Manager - On Trade | AlcoBev | Hyderabad | 4+ yrs
description:
* Opportunity to work with a global premium spirits alcobev company.
* Opportunity to create an impact in a growing market.

**About Our Client**
A leading international premium spirits (alcobev) company with a portfolio of globally renowned luxury and premium brands. The company has a strong presence across international markets and is known for its heritage, craftsmanship and premium brand positioning.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Manage key On-Trade and Off-Trade accounts across Andhra Pradesh & Telangana.
* Build relationships with premium hotels, restaurants, bars, retail chains and key accounts.
* Partner with distributors to drive sales, profitability, distribution and execution.
* Develop channel and city-specific strategies based on market dynamics.
* Drive activations including menu listings, signature serves, experiential programs and retail visibility.
* Track sales performance, market trends, competitor activity and trade investments.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
Consulting Manager role focused on IT consulting delivery in a hybrid work model driving high impact client engagements during day shifts with no travel requirement. The role involves managing complex consulting assignments optimizing technology enabled business solutions and guiding teams to deliver measurable value for global clients while aligning with organizational strategy and societal impact goals.

* Lead end to end IT consulting engagements that translate client business challenges into practical technology enabled solutions that deliver measurable value for stakeholders and the wider community.

* Manage project planning activities including scope definition timeline estimation resource allocation and risk identification to ensure that consulting initiatives are delivered on schedule and within agreed constraints.

* Mentor and coach consulting team members by sharing IT consulting best practices reviewing work products and encouraging continuous learning that strengthens team capabilities and project quality.
* Implement governance and quality review mechanisms that track engagement progress manage dependencies and ensure that all consulting outputs meet internal standards and client expectations.
* Analyze engagement performance metrics and client feedback to identify insights that inform future proposals improve delivery approaches and demonstrate the tangible business impact of IT consulting services.

* Ensure effective stakeholder management through regular status updates issue resolution and expectation setting that foster trust and maintain strong client relationships over the course of the engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive practical experience of eight to ten years in IT consulting with demonstrated success delivering technology driven transformation projects for diverse enterprise clients.
* Apply deep knowledge of consulting methodologies frameworks and structured problem solving techniques to design evidence based recommendations that address complex client business needs.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in analyzing enterprise technology landscapes such as applications infrastructure and integration patterns to determine gaps dependencies and modernization opportunities.
* Exhibit advanced skills in creating detailed documentation including business cases process maps and solution outlines that clearly articulate value drivers and implementation implications.
* Utilize strong stakeholder engagement and communication capabilities to facilitate workshops manage conflicting priorities and build consensus among business and technology teams.
* Leverage familiarity with hybrid work environments collaboration tools and remote facilitation practices to maintain productivity and engagement across distributed consulting teams.
* Bring experience working in day shift consulting contexts supporting global clients through effective time management and coordination without reliance on extensive travel.

title: Market Development Manager - Biopharma
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape the Future of Biopharma Innovation in India**
Agilent Technologies is seeking a strategic, customer-focused, and results-driven
**Market Development Manager, Biopharma**
to accelerate growth across one of the world's fastest-growing biopharmaceutical markets.
  
  
India is rapidly emerging as a global hub for biosimilars, biologics, CDMOs, advanced therapeutics, and pharmaceutical innovation. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence industry direction, shape market strategy, build strategic partnerships, and drive business transformation initiatives that create long-term competitive advantage.
  
  
This position sits at the intersection of science, business, and strategy, working closely with customers, industry leaders, academia, government agencies, and cross-functional Agilent teams to identify growth opportunities, execute strategic initiatives, and accelerate market adoption of Agilent's solutions.
  
  
This is a
**single contributor role**
with significant cross-functional influence and accountability for driving outcomes through strong stakeholder engagement, project leadership, and execution discipline.
  
  
**Most importantly, this is an execution-focused role. Success will be measured not by opportunities identified, but by business outcomes delivered. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution discipline, data-driven decision-making, and relentless project follow-through to ensure initiatives translate into measurable impact.**
**Job Description:**
**Drive Market Growth & Strategic Development**

* Identify emerging opportunities across biologics, biosimilars, peptides, oligonucleotides, ADCs, cell and gene therapy, and other advanced therapeutic modalities.
* Develop and execute market development strategies that accelerate revenue growth and expand Agilent's presence across India's biopharma ecosystem.
* Conduct continuous market intelligence gathering, including customer feedback, competitive assessments, market trends, regulatory developments, investment activities, and emerging technologies.
* Develop robust market monitoring processes, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that enable data-driven decision making.
* Translate market insights into actionable growth initiatives, investment recommendations, and commercial strategies.
* Serve as the voice of the market by identifying unmet customer needs and emerging opportunities before competitors.

**Lead Strategic Collaborations & Partnership Programs**

* Establish and manage strategic collaborations with leading biopharma companies, CDMOs, CROs, research institutions, universities, industry associations, government agencies, and innovation ecosystems.
* Lead collaboration projects from concept through execution, ensuring alignment of objectives, stakeholders, timelines, resources, and expected outcomes.
* Develop collaboration roadmaps and governance structures to maximize business impact.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), scientific leaders, and senior industry decision-makers.
* Convert strategic collaborations into scalable commercial opportunities, customer references, workflow adoption programs, and long-term partnerships.

**Drive Business Transformation & Commercial Innovation**

* Lead strategic business transformation initiatives that improve customer engagement, organizational effectiveness, and growth.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative Go-to-Market (GTM) models that improve customer coverage, workflow adoption, market penetration, and business performance.
* Develop channel strategies, customer segmentation frameworks, territory coverage models, and resource allocation recommendations to maximize growth opportunities.
* Build data-driven investment cases and business proposals that support new growth opportunities, organizational changes, and capability development.
* Partner with leadership teams to design and implement transformative initiatives such as dedicated biopharma channels, workflow-led selling models, partnership ecosystems, and new commercial structures.
* Shape future business strategies by identifying structural gaps and recommending scalable solutions that enhance customer experience and commercial effectiveness.

**Lead Execution & Deliver Results**
This role requires exceptional execution capability and project leadership.
  
  

* Establish clear project objectives, KPIs, milestones, governance mechanisms, and success metrics for strategic initiatives.
* Own project tracking and performance monitoring to ensure initiatives remain on schedule and deliver intended outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across commercial, marketing, applications, business units, and leadership teams.
* Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, escalate issues when necessary, and maintain momentum across complex initiatives.
* Hold stakeholders accountable and ensure commitments are translated into action.
* Develop executive updates and progress reviews to provide visibility into project performance and business impact.
* Foster a culture of execution excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**The successful candidate will be known for making things happen. They will relentlessly push initiatives forward, connect strategy to execution, and ensure that projects move beyond discussion and planning into measurable results.**
**Enable Commercial Success**

* Support strategic account planning and opportunity development across key biopharma customers.
* Partner with sales, applications, and marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth and market adoption.
* Provide market expertise and workflow insights to strengthen customer engagement strategies.
* Champion a One Agilent approach across strategic customer accounts and growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in biopharma, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare technology, business development, market development, strategic marketing, consulting, or related fields.
* Strong understanding of India's biopharma ecosystem, including biologics, biosimilars, CDMOs, CROs, and emerging therapeutic modalities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: FIS Integrity - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior, FAAS, EY GDS Assurance**
**About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client–serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help world’s leading companies meet their audit requirements.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced FIS integrity professional to join EY FAAS team to help drive growth and manage delivery teams, bring subject matter expertise around FIS Integrity solution of our FAAS services.
  
  
The Senior should be competent to manage a portfolio of clients and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of the work as per EY Global Standards for our FIS integrity team. While the Senior will be based out of our Gurugram or Bengaluru or Mumbai offices, the individual will be responsible for supporting EY practices and clients across the Global Market. Also, the individual will be required to travel to other countries (short-term) for executing the client engagements.
  
  
 
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
The Senior will manage teams of FAAS professionals during engagements covering a broad spectrum of FIS Integrity areas. The individual will be responsible for the following tasks:
  
  

* Assist in FIS Integrity projects, including design, implementation, configuration, and integration of FIS Integrity modules.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements, contribute to solution design, and provide expertise on FIS Integrity functionalities.
* Analyze and optimize treasury processes, identifying areas for improvement and supporting the implementation of best practices.
* Participate in client demonstrations and presentations, highlighting the capabilities and benefits of FIS Integrity solutions.
* Assist in evaluating and assessing vendor solutions, participating in vendor evaluations, and providing recommendations for FIS Integrity implementation.
* Contribute to system testing, including creating test scenarios and ensuring successful data migration and validation for FIS Integrity functionalities.
* Support the development and delivery of training programs and workshops to enhance end-user understanding and proficiency in FIS Integrity modules.
* Maintain awareness of the latest industry trends, regulations, and advancements in treasury management, and share knowledge and insights with the team.
* Support project management activities, such as project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring project progress.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure successful implementation, adherence to project timelines, and achievement of project goals.
* Provide ongoing support and maintenance for FIS Integrity modules, addressing functional issues and assisting with enhancements as required.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and industry standards.
* Assist in engagement planning, budgeting, execution, and management.

**Qualifications, Skills And Experience**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-7 years of relevant experience in treasury management, preferably with exposure to FIS Integrity.
* FIS Integrity certification and hands-on experience with FIS Integrity would be advantageous.

**Experience in the following areas:**

* Understanding of treasury and risk management processes, including cash management, bank management, liquidity management, debt & investment management, and financial risk management.
* Knowledge in configuring FIS Integrity functionalities i.e., cash positioning and forecasting, bank account administration, payments processing, foreign exchange, debt and investment management, accounting, compliance, and reporting.
* Experience in integrating FIS Integrity with other systems and external platforms.
* Familiarity with financial instruments, derivatives, and hedging strategies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Project involvement experience, including the ability to support multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work in a team and establish credibility as a trusted advisor to clients.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to interact with management at all levels (EY and clients).
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

\* Quality of stakeholder engagement.

\* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.

A Storyteller

You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.

description:

title: Property Manager
description:

Property Manager
  
  
**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually | Full-Time | Remote | Eastern Time Hours**
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property-management files.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process-driven property-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.

**Requirements**

* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task-management system.
* Strong follow-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Direct property-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high-volume, service-based, operations-heavy or SLA-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.

Remote Technology Requirements
  
  

* Dual-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls

**Compensation**
Total annual compensation ranges from
**C$30,000 to C$36,000**
, based on experience, qualifications and performance.
  
  
Candidates with direct property-management experience, strong owner and tenant communication skills, and proven success managing a high volume of active files may be considered near the top of the range.
  
  
Complete details regarding base compensation and performance bonuses will be shared during the interview process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview from our recruitment partner within 24–48 hours of applying.

Bozzo Cabs is building a new urban mobility platform, starting with Hyderabad.

We're looking for a
**GTM & Growth Manager**
to take ownership of how we enter the market, acquire customers and build sustainable growth.

This is a hands-on founding-team role—not a traditional marketing position. You'll work across GTM, customer acquisition, pricing, partnerships, competitor analysis and business strategy.

**What you'll work on**

• Build and execute Bozzo's Hyderabad GTM strategy.

• Identify high-potential customer segments, locations and growth opportunities.

• Build acquisition strategies across digital, offline, community and partnership channels.

• Experiment with social media, influencers, referrals, WhatsApp, campuses, offices, apartments and local communities.

• Build referral and partnership-led growth loops.

• Track the customer funnel from Awareness → Install → First Ride → Repeat Ride → Referral.

• Analyze CAC, conversion, retention, repeat rides and campaign ROI.

• Study competitors such as Uber, Rapido and Ola, including pricing, offers and positioning.

• Help shape Bozzo's pricing and promotional strategy.

• Identify market gaps and opportunities across Hyderabad.

• Continuously test, measure and improve growth initiatives.

**What we're looking for**

• 4–6 years of experience in one or more of:

• Growth / Customer Acquisition

• GTM / Business Strategy

• Digital Marketing

• Consumer Internet

• Mobility / Ride-hailing

• Marketplace / D2C / E-commerce

• Startup environments

**You should be:**

• Highly entrepreneurial and execution-oriented

• Comfortable with numbers, CAC, conversion, retention and ROI

• Strong at market and competitor analysis

• Creative in developing new customer-growth ideas

• Comfortable with both online and offline growth

• Strong in communication, partnerships and negotiation

• Familiar with the Hyderabad market

• Comfortable working with ambiguity, limited resources and high ownership

**What makes this role different**

We're not looking for someone who only manages social media, runs ads or prepares reports.

We're looking for someone who can connect:

Market → Customer → Pricing → Acquisition → First Ride → Repeat Ride → Referral → Growth

You'll have the freedom to identify opportunities, propose experiments and take them from idea → execution → measurement → scale.

**Founding-Team Opportunity**

This is an equity-only founding-team opportunity.

You'll work closely with the founders and have direct ownership over one of the most important challenges for an early-stage mobility company:

Equity Only

description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
The IT&D Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end-to-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.
  
  
This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high-quality services.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Service Accountability
* Own the end-to-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
* Act as the business-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.
* Ensure services are operated as integrated end-to-end value streams, not disconnected vendor silos.
* Supplier & SIAM-Oriented Service Orchestration
* Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support.
* Operate as part of a SIAM-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
* Hold suppliers accountable for outcomes, not effort, including SLA performance, incident quality, proactive problem prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Service Performance & Governance
* Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
* Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:
* Business impact
* Service stability
* User experience
* Root cause and trend insights
* Stakeholder & Business Relationship Management
* Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
* Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
* Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions using clear, business-focused language.
* Represent operational readiness, risk, and service impact in business governance forums.
* Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management
* Ensure robust incident and major incident management across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
* Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered.
* Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.
* Change, Release & Service Transition Oversight
* Govern supplier-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
* Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes, including:
* Support models
* Knowledge transfer
* Runbooks
* Monitoring and alerting
* Service desk enablement
* Operational Risk, Resilience & Compliance
* Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
* Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Continual Improvement, Automation & Efficiency
* Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:
* Reduce manual effort
* Improve stability
* Lower run costs
* Enhance user experience
* Financial & Contractual Management (Run Services)
* Manage run-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
* Ensure cost transparency and value-for-money from service providers.
* Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM-based environment.
* Strong expertise in ITIL-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers and drive end-to-end service outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
* Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
* Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
* Deep hands-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB, service mapping, and dependency modelling to enable true end-to-end service ownership.
* Experience defining and governing ITSM workflows, SLAs/XLAs, dashboards, and reporting within ServiceNow, and using ServiceNow data and insights to drive operational performance, problem reduction, and continual service improvement.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Stable, predictable services with minimal business disruption
* Suppliers operating as one integrated service ecosystem
* Reduced incident volumes and repeat issues
* Clear service ownership and accountability
* Improved business satisfaction and trust in IT delivery

The skills for success
  
  
Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. These services are organized into three capability areas - Strategic Services, Compliance, Risk & Operational Services, and Technology Services:
  
  

* Strategic Services help clients define fit-for-purpose operating models for their commodities, define the changes required to realize that vision, and develop a roadmap for execution
* Compliance, Risk & Operational Services assess the existing compliance, risk, and operational processes of our clients leveraging proprietary tools to yield insights for improvement or optimization
* Technology Services deliver custom and package technology solutions that help our clients manage their commodity business and associated risk & compliance exposures.
* Managers are responsible for setting goals that align with organizational objectives

* Managing multiple project budget, monitoring expenditure and costs as the project progresses.
* Facilitating the appointment of individuals to project teams.

**Qualifications**

**Functional Requirements –**

* 10 – 15 years of experience in business processes across Trading and Contract management, Physical Commodity Trading and their related financial derivatives, Scheduling, Mark to Market, Vars, Write on/Write offs, Inventory Management, Invoicing and Accounting.
* Familiarity with Pricing tools such as ZEMA
* Understanding of deal pricing and pricing strategies

title: Assistant Manager Hospitality
description:
**Assistant Manager – Hospitality & Guest Experience**

**Location:**
Veltoor, Telangana
*(Primarily site-based)*

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
3+ years

**Compensation:**
₹5–6 LPA

**About Soul Forest**

We are a business that transforms barren lands into biodiverse forests through an 80:20 model—80% nature reserve, 20% eco-sensitive living, wellness, and livelihoods. Our 250-acre pilot in Veltoor, Telangana is a living lab of restoration and regeneration. Founded by Earthshot Prize-winning climate entrepreneurs, Soul Forest aims to scale this model to 100,000 acres globally in the next decade.

At Soul Forest, hospitality is more than accommodation—it's about creating meaningful experiences that reconnect people with nature. Every guest who visits our forest should leave feeling welcomed, cared for, and inspired by the simplicity, beauty, and purpose of the place.

**The Role**

As
**Assistant Manager – Hospitality & Guest Experience**
, you'll help shape every visitor's experience at Soul Forest—from intimate leadership visits to events hosting
**200+ guests**
.

You'll welcome a diverse range of visitors, including investors, partners, collaborators, employees, families, children, ecology experts, senior professionals, and older guests. Each experience should be thoughtful, seamless, and tailored to the needs of the audience while reflecting the Soul Forest story.

**Where Hospitality Meets Restoration**

Soul Forest is a living, evolving forest destination where restoration and hospitality come together. It isn't a resort, farm stay, or weekend getaway.

Visitors step into a landscape being restored into a thriving forest ecosystem. Every visit should reflect our purpose while delivering the comfort, warmth, and service standards today's urban guests expect.

Whether welcoming investors, partners, employees, families, children, or ecology enthusiasts, you'll create experiences that are thoughtful, seamless, and true to the Soul Forest story.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end guest journey, serving as the primary point of contact from pre-arrival coordination to departure.
* Design and continuously improve visitor experiences across retreats, workshops, events, and guided visits.
* Plan and oversee every stage of the guest journey—from arrival and accommodation to food, wayfinding, safety, and departure.
* Maintain high standards of cleanliness, comfort, presentation, and hospitality across all guest-facing spaces.
* Curate authentic forest experiences that balance rural charm with the comfort and service standards urban guests expect.
* Coordinate seamlessly with internal teams, vendors, and service partners to deliver exceptional visitor experiences.
* Develop SOPs, checklists, and operating processes that improve consistency, efficiency, and service quality.
* Recruit, train, and guide hospitality staff, volunteers, and service partners.
* Gather guest feedback, resolve concerns proactively, and continuously improve the overall experience.
* Embed sustainability into everyday hospitality through thoughtful sourcing, waste reduction, and responsible resource use.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, you'll:

* Build the hospitality systems and standards needed to confidently host visits and events for
  **200-500 guests**
  .
* Establish Soul Forest as a destination known for thoughtful, seamless, purpose-led hospitality.
* Become the trusted cross-functional lead who brings teams together to deliver exceptional visitor experiences.
* Create experiences that guests genuinely remember, recommend, and associate with the Soul Forest story.
* Raise the benchmark for hospitality by embedding quality, care, and sustainability into everyday operations.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of experience in hospitality operations, guest experience, events, experiential travel, or resort management.
* Experience in boutique resorts, eco-resorts, wellness retreats, farm stays, or nature-based destinations is preferred.
* Strong operational planning and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Experience building SOPs, managing vendors, and leading hospitality teams.
* A natural host with excellent communication and attention to detail.
* Someone who instinctively notices what guests need before they're asked.
* Passion for sustainability and creating meaningful visitor experiences.
* Comfortable working primarily from Veltoor, including weekends when required.
* **Fluency in Telugu is mandatory.**
* A hospitality qualification is preferred but not essential.

**This Role May Not Suit You If...**

* You see hospitality only as managing rooms or guest services.
* You prefer established systems instead of building new ones.
* You enjoy interacting with guests but not the planning and coordination behind the scenes.
* You're uncomfortable managing multiple teams, vendors, and changing priorities simultaneously.
* You view sustainability as a branding exercise rather than an operational responsibility.
* You're not comfortable working primarily from Veltoor.

**Why Join Soul Forest?**

**Build Something Unique**
– Help create one of India's most distinctive nature-based destinations.

**Shape the Guest Experience**
– Design the standards, systems, and experiences visitors will remember.

**Create Real Impact**
– Help thousands of people experience ecological restoration in a meaningful way.

**Grow With Ownership**
– Build teams, improve systems, and take ownership of a function that will continue to scale with the organisation.

**How to Apply**

If this sounds like you, please apply using the form below.

**Please complete the Google Form below and upload:**

* **Your CV**
* **A brief cover note answering:**

1. Why does nature-based hospitality excite you?
2. Tell us about one guest experience or event you managed.

By applying for this position, you consent to Soul Forest collecting, processing, and using the personal information you provide, including through AI-assisted screening and recruitment tools, for the purpose of evaluating your application, in accordance with the
**Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)**
and our applicable privacy practices.

**Fill out this Google Form:**

https://forms.gle/Uhxg7gDCR9pn6iB88

(If you're unable to click the link, please copy and paste it into your browser.)

**Note:**
Only responses submitted through the Google Form will be considered.

**Application Deadline:**
**19th October, 2026 | 11:59 PM IST**

title: PM II, SPIV Vendor Mgmt, Verifications & Risk Management Ops - VRMO
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about driving vendor performance and operational excellence? Do you thrive in environments where data-driven insights shape strategic decisions and cross-functional collaboration is key to success?
  
  
The Selling Partner Identity Verification Vendor Management (SPIV VM) team is responsible for end-to-end vendor governance, managing vendor relationships, performance oversight, and operational excellence across seller-facing service vendors. SPIV VM partners with VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA (Third Party Security Assessment), SPS VM, Finance, and Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) to ensure vendor compliance, cost efficiency, and service quality throughout the vendor lifecycle — from shortlisting and selection through contract management and performance governance.
  
  
A Vendor Manager in SPIV VM owns vendor performance management, drives operational improvements, and ensures vendors meet contractual SLAs and quality benchmarks. They validate vendor data through internal dashboards, manage invoicing accuracy, collaborate with Finance on cost savings initiatives, coordinate with VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, and TPSA on vendor assessments and compliance, and support governance framework implementation. This role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder management across multiple teams, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in vendor operations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and performance against SLAs and KPIs
* Validate vendor-reported volumes against internal dashboard data to ensure invoicing accuracy
* Partner with Finance to track cost savings and budget adherence
* Collaborate with SPS VM and GCP during vendor shortlisting and selection processes
* Support governance framework implementation and ensure vendor compliance
* Conduct root cause analysis on vendor performance misses and drive corrective actions
* Develop and maintain vendor performance reporting (weekly, monthly)
* Lead risk assessments and vendor governance processes within SPIV VM
* Identify process improvement opportunities using data-driven insights
* Manage stakeholder communication across VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA, Finance, and Leadership teams
* Ensure contract scope, timelines, and deliverables align with business objectives
* Support change management initiatives related to vendor operations

A day in the life
  
  
You will start your day reviewing operational dashboards to identify anomalies in vendor performance metrics. You may then dive deep into a variance analysis to understand why a particular metric is trending below target, presenting your findings to your manager. In the afternoon, you might work on building an automated report that consolidates inputs from multiple teams, or partner with Data Engineering to refine data pipelines for reporting needs. Your work directly influences decisions on operational strategy and process improvements.
  
  
**About The Team**
The SPIV Vendor Management team operates a Dual-Face Model — an Operations Face covering onboarding, contracts, tech integration, and performance management, and a Cost Face covering budgets, invoices, accruals, POs, and spend management. The team manages processes across four pillars: Onboarding, Spend Management, Vendor Performance, and Vendor Strategy & Data Analytics. The VM role sits within the Operations & Performance function, serving as the bridge between business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams (VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA) — owning vendor governance, performance monitoring, and operational decisions. The structure is designed for interchangeability and continuity across the vendor management function.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

The Manager, Customer Success – Commercial Enablement and End of Support leads three critical functions which protect and grow revenue across Blackbaud. This leader partners across the company to reduce noise and friction points, so we target the right accounts, with the right message, at the right time. Second, this role manages our Commercial Enablement CSM, who is responsible for building Customer Success Manager (CSM) proficiency in generating employee sales leads, positioning the impact and value the customer is receiving from the solution, and equipping CSMs to identify and combat risk. Third, this role will manage our End of Support (EOS) CSM, who guides customers through end-of-sale/end-of-life product transitions; including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and partner with internal teams in coordinated cross-sell/up-sell to replacement solutions.
  
  
This role is based in Hyderabad and the expected shift is US hours (6:30pm – 3:30am IST).
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Outbound Program Leadership: Lead and manage the day-to-day performance of the temporary-worker Outbound Caller program, setting clear expectations, workflows, and quality standards for the team.
* Quality & Coaching: Monitor and evaluate call quality, provide real-time and ongoing coaching, and build training and proficiency programs that raise caller performance consistently over time.

* Targeting & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Data/Analytics, and other teams to reduce noise and friction points in the calling process, ensuring the program targets the right accounts at the right time.

* CSM Sales Skills Enablement: Guide the development of programs that build CSM proficiency in identifying and generating employee sales leads within their accounts.
* Risk & Churn Mitigation: Ensure CSMs are equipped with the tools, training, and playbooks needed to identify and combat account risk and potential churn.
* Competitive Intelligence: Champion the use of competitive intelligence to inform CSM conversations, protect revenue, and play defense against competitive threats.
* End of Support (EOS) Program Leadership: Manage the End of Support (EOS) CSM, providing direction and oversight as they guide customers through end-of-sale/end-of-life product transitions, including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and coordinated cross-sell/up-sell to replacement solutions.
* EOS Adoption & Retention Oversight: Ensure the EOS CSM drives platform adoption, retention, and success planning for assigned accounts, holding the role accountable for revenue growth and retention outcomes.
* EOS Cross-Functional Coordination: Support the EOS CSM in partnering with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Product, Operations, and Support to resolve issues, manage escalations, and channel customer feedback into product and process improvements.
* EOS Performance Accountability: Review key account KPIs and success-plan progress for EOS accounts, ensuring the CSM's efforts translate into measurable client outcomes and a positive customer transition experience.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing, customer success or sales role within a B2B SaaS environment, including 2+ years in a management capacity with direct reports.
* Experience managing a temporary, contingent, or outsourced workforce, including onboarding, quality monitoring, and performance management.
* Demonstrated success coaching individuals or teams to proficiency, with measurable improvements in call quality and performance outcomes.
* Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, working with Sales, Marketing, and Data/Analytics teams to refine targeting and remove friction from outbound processes.
* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to interpret call and performance data to make data-driven decisions.
* Experience with sales or enablement functions, including building CSM or seller proficiency in lead generation, customer value discussions, risk mitigation, and competitive positioning.
* Familiarity with churn and retention dynamics in a B2B SaaS environment, and how competitive intelligence informs account strategy.
* Excellent communication and coaching skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable guidance for frontline team members.
* Familiarity with end-of-sale/end-of-life (EOS) product transitions, including contract restructuring, migration and cutover planning, and cross-sell/up-sell strategy, and the ability to coach a CSM through this process.
* Experience coaching CSMs on consultative, technical account conversations, with the goal of driving value realization, outcome achievement, and retention.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Hyderabad)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Sports Med & Extremities) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.

title: Manager – Revenue (Hyderabad)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.
