title: VP, GTM
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is seeking a Vice President, Head of Go-To-Market India to serve as the senior India leader for its customer-facing GTM organization. This executive will be responsible for aligning India’s GTM strategy with Seismic’s global priorities, building scalable organizational capability, and leading the next phase of growth across Customer Success, Renewals, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Implementation, Technical Account Management, Project Management, and other GTM functions as the organization expands.
  
  
The role will have dual reporting to the India Managing Director / President and the Chief Revenue Officer. This leader will partner closely with global GTM executives to ensure India operates as an integrated, high-impact extension of the global business while also building a strong India leadership bench, operating model, and culture of accountability.
  
  
Initially, two Senior Directors will report into this leader. One Senior Director will oversee implementation, solution consulting, technical account management, project management, and related services functions. The second Senior Director will oversee Customer Success and Renewals Management. The scope is expected to expand as Seismic continues to scale its GTM presence and leadership capability in India.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 20+ years of progressive leadership experience, including executive level leadership across GTM, Customer Success, Services, Renewals, Solution Consulting, Support, Sales, or related customer-facing functions.
* Significant experience building and scaling multi-function customer-facing organizations in India within a global enterprise SaaS, B2B software, or technology product company.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in a US-headquartered, global, matrixed organization with senior stakeholders across geographies and functions.
* Strong understanding of recurring revenue models, customer lifecycle management, retention, renewals, adoption, value realization, and customer growth levers.
* Proven track record of developing senior leaders, building leadership bench strength, and designing scalable operating models.
* Strong commercial judgment, data-driven decision-making, and ability to connect customer, talent, operational, and financial priorities.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence CRO, President, MD, functional executives, and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to bring clarity, pace, and disciplined execution in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related discipline required. Advanced degree preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience leading or partnering closely with global Customer Success, Services, Solution Consulting, Renewals, or Support organizations.
* Experience scaling an India center from early or mid-stage maturity into a strategic global capability hub.
* Exposure to executive-level workforce planning, location strategy, customer delivery models, and leadership hiring.
* Experience improving operating leverage through process design, tooling, automation, AI, or shared operating rhythms.

**Success Profile**
The successful candidate will combine executive maturity with hands-on scaling judgment. They will be able to operate at the strategy level with global leaders while also building the leadership systems, operating cadence, and team capability required for consistent execution in India. They should be commercially strong, customer-obsessed, comfortable in a matrixed environment, and capable of earning trust across India and global leadership teams.
  
  
**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the India GTM leadership mandate and translate global business priorities into a clear India strategy, operating model, and execution plan.
* Partner with the India Managing Director / President, CRO, and global GTM leaders to align India capability with global customer, revenue, retention, and growth priorities.
* Lead and develop India based GTM leaders across Services, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Renewals, Implementation, TAM, Project Management, and adjacent functions.
* Build a scalable leadership structure and operating rhythm that supports current priorities while preparing the organization for future expansion.
* Create strong accountability across capacity planning, delivery readiness, customer outcomes, retention, renewal execution, operational health, and talent development.
* Establish governance mechanisms across global and India teams to improve decision-making, escalation management, cross-functional alignment, and business visibility.
* Drive collaboration across Customer Success, Renewals, Services, Solution Consulting, Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, People, and other partner functions.
* Develop senior leaders and build a strong internal succession pipeline for India GTM leadership roles.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, customer experience, and operating leverage through process improvement, technology, automation, and AI adoption.
* Represent India GTM priorities with executive stakeholders and serve as a senior escalation point for critical customer, talent, and operational matters.
* Shape a high-performance culture grounded in customer impact, commercial judgment, ownership, inclusion, and global collaboration.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Wealth Hub Client Services & Technical Delivery, AVP
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The AVP, Client Services & Technical Delivery will be responsible for client onboarding, technical integrations, platform operations, API enablement, file feed management, Corporate Actions governance and automation, Security Master operations, and operational support for the Wealth Hub platform.
  
  
This role serves as the primary liaison between clients, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Data Operations, and SaaS Operations teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, operational stability, and ongoing support of Wealth Hub services.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong client-facing skills with deep technical expertise in APIs, enterprise integrations, file feed onboarding and management, cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, operational automation, investment operations, Corporate Actions governance and automation, Security Master management, and enterprise SaaS platform delivery. The candidate should be equally comfortable engaging with business stakeholders, operations teams, developers, architects, and client technology organizations.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important to Us**
Wealth Hub is a strategic platform supporting wealth managers, sponsors, asset managers, custodians, and model providers through secure, scalable, and highly integrated technology solutions.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring successful client implementations, operational readiness, data integrity, platform stability, Corporate Actions processing, Security Master governance, integration reliability, and continuous automation initiatives that support future growth and scalability.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As
**AVP, Client Services & Technical Delivery**
, you will:
  
  
**Client Services & Delivery**

* Coordinate client onboarding, implementation, and integration projects.
* Serve as the primary technical contact for strategic clients.
* Manage client escalations and drive issues through resolution.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, technical workshops, and API demonstrations.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to ensure successful client outcomes.
* Coordinate onboarding of sponsors, asset managers, wealth managers, custodians, and third-party providers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on operational workflows, integrations, and platform capabilities.

**API & Integration Management**

* Lead API onboarding and integration initiatives.
* Develop, test, troubleshoot, and demonstrate APIs end-to-end.
* Create sample code, payloads, technical documentation, and testing artifacts.
* Partner directly with client development teams during implementation and support.
* Troubleshoot authentication, connectivity, data validation, and integration issues.
* Support REST APIs, web services, event-based integrations, and secure connectivity solutions.
* Assist clients with API troubleshooting, onboarding, testing, and adoption.

**Data Integration & File Feed Management**

* Lead support of inbound and outbound file-based integrations.
* Manage connectivity with sponsors, asset managers, custodians, wealth managers, market data vendors, and external service providers.
* Define file specifications, mapping requirements, transformation rules, and validation controls.
* Support integration technologies including SFTP, FTPS, APIs, message-based interfaces, and cloud-based data exchanges.
* Troubleshoot file delivery failures, processing exceptions, transformation issues, and reconciliation breaks.
* Coordinate testing and implementation of new client and vendor data feeds.
* Design automated monitoring, alerting, and recovery processes for critical file feeds.
* Establish operational controls and service level monitoring across integration workflows.
* Develop operational reporting and dashboards to measure feed health, reliability, and performance.

**Platform Operations & Software Delivery**

* Coordinate software releases, patches, hotfixes, and production deployments.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release validation.
* Drive troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex production issues.
* Ensure that data, overnight processing, and platform services are validated and available for client use by 7:00 AM ET.
* Drive operational automation initiatives using scripting, workflow orchestration, and DevOps tooling.
* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Participate in disaster recovery exercises and resiliency testing initiatives.

**Corporate Actions & Security Master Governance**

* Drive Corporate Actions automation initiatives to reduce manual intervention, operational risk, and processing exceptions.
* Manage Corporate Actions (CA) operations across the Wealth Hub platform.
* Monitor daily Corporate Actions activity and ensure timely processing and issue resolution.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Corporate Actions-related incidents, escalations, and client inquiries.
* Maintain Security Master integrity through ongoing monitoring, reconciliation, and data quality controls.
* Coordinate with internal and external data providers to resolve security reference data issues.
* Implement controls and operational processes to support data accuracy and platform resiliency.

**Security & Cloud Operations**

* Support certificate management, mTLS connectivity, encryption, and secure integrations.
* Partner with Infrastructure teams on Azure platform services and operational improvements.
* Support Azure Key Vault integration and secrets management best practices.

**What We Value**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms within financial services or other regulated industries.
* Deep expertise in Corporate Actions operations, lifecycle event processing, automation, exception management, and governance controls.
* Subject matter expertise in APIs, secure integrations, mTLS authentication, certificate management, SFTP connectivity, and enterprise data exchange frameworks.

Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals

title: AVP Global Client Partner
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future, live the leadership behaviors, uphold our Values, and nurture our people and culture to create a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As AVP Client Partner, you will make an impact by developing and executing account strategy, driving sustainable revenue growth, managing P&L performance, and strengthening executive client relationships. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences account leadership team and work collaboratively with Markets, client relationship managers, sales, pre-sales, service lines, alliance partners, and client stakeholders.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Define and execute the account strategy and plan, aligning customer outcomes with a clear vision for growth across the Novartis account.
* Own P&L performance and drive revenue growth in line with or above the market, while identifying and addressing account-level challenges.
* Co-own offering positioning for India and DACH Life Sciences accounts by identifying portfolio gaps, shaping offering strategy and roadmaps, and managing opportunities from ideation through sales closure.
* Lead sales and account-penetration activities by translating business problems into technology-enabled solutions, qualifying opportunities, and partnering with client relationship managers and sales teams.
* Direct deal pursuits end to end within the service line, ensuring effective pre-sales engagement through workshops, digital dialogues, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, and personally engaging priority clients to credentialize deals.
* Shape thought leadership and portfolio strategy, engage external analysts, and drive market education and commercial conversations.
* Own strategic alliance and vendor relationships, developing partnerships that improve business outcomes and support sell-with growth.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead through Personal Leadership, Organizational Leadership, and Business Leadership, including building trust and inclusion, setting bold strategic direction, maintaining client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability, and operating with financial acumen.

**Measures of success**

* TCV growth and revenue growth, including relative growth compared with leading competitors.
* Portfolio mix and revenue mix across service lines.
* Client deployments of intellectual property, accelerators, and solutions.
* Partnership growth, including sell-with TCV.
* Improvement in average billing rates.
* Diversity and inclusive leadership outcomes.
* Effective ownership of strategic-priority socialization, new portfolio development within existing logos, deal pursuits, sales strategy, account planning, growth priorities, and differentiated solution design.

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in a senior leadership role.
* A minimum of 15 years of complex solutioning experience, supported by broad technical experience.
* A minimum of 15 years of experience in the assigned functional or technology area, with applicable market-standard certifications.
* Demonstrated capability in account strategy, account planning, sales strategy, P&L management, revenue growth, and end-to-end deal pursuits.
* Experience translating business challenges into technology-enabled solutions and engaging senior client stakeholders in commercial and solution conversations.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, and Leading the Business.
* Embodiment of Cognizant Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Senior leadership experience managing a large portfolio and working with large, globally distributed teams.
* Domain expertise across verticals, with the ability to apply industry, geography, and practice-area insight to client priorities.
* A track record of bringing products and offerings to market and leveraging organizational capabilities to support differentiated offers and solutions.
* Experience developing strategic alliances, engaging external analysts, and shaping thought leadership and portfolio strategy.
* Strong executive presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build trust across client, sales, pre-sales, service-line, and partner stakeholders.

**Work model**
The working arrangement for this role will be based on business and client requirements and will be communicated during the hiring process. Working arrangements may change based on the project, business, and client requirements. We will always be clear about role expectations and support a healthy work-life balance through our wellbeing programs.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Consider the transferable experiences and unique skills that enable you to bring new and valuable perspectives to this role

title: Deputy Manager - Operations (Field & Delivery)
description:
**Introduction**
**Come move the world with us!**
Wake up each day to be part of a
**global movement**
. A movement to make an impact. A movement to go for it! A movement to provide best-in class solutions. A movement to be empowered. A movement to do the right thing.
  
  
Make AIT Worldwide Logistics the next stop on your career journey!
  
  
See what our teammates say about working at AIT Worldwide Logistics .
  
  
**Overview**
**The Deputy Manager - Operations (Field & Delivery)**
is responsible for leading field delivery operations, customer site execution, transportation coordination, warehouse interface and service-quality governance on behalf of AIT. The role manages supervisors and field resources deployed at customer sites, airports, warehouses, distribution centers and project locations, ensuring safe, timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery execution.
  
  
The incumbent acts as the operational escalation point between customers, transport vendors, warehouse partners, customs brokers, airlines and internal operations teams. The role requires strong ownership of delivery KPIs, team supervision, exception management, vendor performance, customer communication, and continuous improvement in field operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Field Delivery Operations Leadership - Plan, supervise, and monitor pickup, delivery, loading, unloading, and customer-site operations across assigned locations to ensure efficient and compliant service execution.
* AIT Site Representation - Act as the primary AIT representative at customer sites, ensuring adherence to customer instructions, site protocols, and agreed service standards.
* Team Supervision - Lead field supervisors and operational teams, ensuring effective resource deployment, productivity, professional conduct, and service delivery excellence.
* Transportation & Vendor Coordination - Coordinate with transport vendors, warehouses, drivers, customs brokers, airports, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operational execution and service continuity.
* White Glove & Project Delivery Management - Oversee high-value and specialized deliveries, ensuring safe handling, unpacking, positioning, installation support, and successful customer handover.
* Shipment Visibility & Exception Control - Maintain shipment visibility, milestone accuracy, and proactive communication while managing operational exceptions, delays, damages, and recovery actions.
* POD & Documentation Governance - Ensure timely collection, validation, and submission of PODs, delivery records, customer acknowledgements, and other operational documentation.
* Operational KPI & Service Quality - Drive performance against key metrics including on-time delivery, POD closure, service failures, damage prevention, and customer satisfaction.
* Customer Service & Escalation Management - Manage customer escalations, provide timely updates, and coordinate corrective actions to ensure high service levels and business continuity.
* Safety, Security & Compliance - Ensure compliance with safety standards, security protocols, customer requirements, regulatory guidelines, and AIT operating procedures.
* Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement - Lead root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Vendor Development & Quality Assurance - Monitor vendor performance, support training initiatives, participate in audits, and drive continuous improvement to strengthen operational reliability and compliance.

**Qualifications**

* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent degree in any field
* 5-6 years in freight forwarding, transportation, delivery operations, field supervision, warehousing, or logistics operations.
* Minimum 2-3 years supervising field executives, delivery teams, transport vendors or customer-site operations.
* Inductry exposure - Freight forwarding, airfreight operations, last-mile delivery, white glove delivery, warehousing, project logistics, data-center / high-value cargo operations

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Field delivery and transportation operations management
* Customer-site coordination and delivery supervision
* White glove / high-value cargo handling awareness
* Shipment tracking, milestone reporting, and POD governance
* Team supervision, shift planning, and field resource deployment
* Vendor, driver, warehouse, and handling-agent coordination
* Issue resolution, escalation handling, and root-cause analysis
* Safety, compliance, security, and customer-site protocol awareness
* Documentation control and operational reporting
* Working knowledge of Excel, Outlook, CargoWise or similar logistics systems preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

* CargoWise user training or equivalent logistics system training
* Logistics / Supply Chain / Transportation certification
* Safety and security awareness training
* Dangerous Goods awareness training where applicable
* Customer-site induction or white glove handling training where applicable

**What AIT Can Offer You**
In addition to base compensation, AIT offers a growing suite of competitive benefits to help our teammates realize their full financial, well-being, personal and professional potential.
  
  
**AIT Worldwide Logistics Benefits Available Across All Global Markets**

* Vacation/holiday time
* Global employee support program
* Mindfulness tools
* Professional development
* Company events and gatherings
* Five paid volunteer hours through our AIT Cares program

Our competitive employee benefits packages may vary by region and country.
  
  
**About AIT Worldwide**
**About AIT Worldwide Logistics:**
AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. For more than 45 years, the America’s-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, food, government, healthcare, high-tech, industrial and life sciences. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, Middle East and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .
  
  
AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.

* Tech Stack Familiarity: Hands-on experience navigating interconnected ecosystems including Salesforce and Enterprise General Ledger systems like NetSuite.
* Technical Literacy: Solid foundation understanding XML/JSON or scripting languages (like Python) to effectively collaborate with IT developer resources on API integrations.
* Adaptability & Leadership: Demonstrated capability to lead projects through ambiguous situations, manage shifting priorities, and seamlessly adopt new financial technologies.
* Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate accounting needs into clear functional specifications.

title: Engagement Manager- HCM Implementation (US Shift)
description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)- HYD based**
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
  
  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.

**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

**Description**
ROC Overview
  
  
Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon facilities and to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings.
  
  
In addition to this tactical problem solving, ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
  
  
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Purview of a Supply Chain Manager at ROC
  
  
A Supply Chain Manager facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity.
  
  
The candidate should have a basic understanding of the logistics space and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. She/he should be able to come up with process improvements and drive them through completion.

* Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Operation, Tech/Integration, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)

* Developing and/or understanding performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
* Scoping out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by ROC.
* Identifying the business impact of trends and making data backed decisions.
* Escalating problems or variances in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 1+ years of supply chain experience
* Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
* Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/related discipline with 2-4 years of work experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Master's degree or above in relevant field of operations
* Knowledge of analytics & statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL & ETL DW concepts
* Logistics/transportation background and lean/six sigma training is a plus

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

 At Azurity, our Customer Experience (CX) and Digital Transformation team is expanding as we continue to invest in next\-generation CRM, AI, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities. We are building a modern, data\-driven commercial ecosystem powered by Salesforce, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, AI, and omnichannel engagement technologies that support our growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, and Patient Services.
   

  

 We are seeking dynamic, highly motivated, and hands\-on professionals who thrive in fast\-paced environments, embrace change, and are passionate about solving business challenges through technology. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping the future of our CRM and customer engagement capabilities while working alongside cross\-functional teams across the organization.
   

  

 The Manager \- Salesforce Administration \& Business Analysis serves as a senior member of the CRM team, responsible for Salesforce platform administration, business stakeholder support, and driving continuous improvement of CRM processes and capabilities. This role combines Salesforce administration, business analysis, solution design, user adoption, data management, and cross\-functional collaboration responsibilities to help maximize the value of the CRM platform across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Patient Services, and other business functions.

This individual will work closely with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Data \& Analytics, Compliance, and IT teams to support the continued evolution of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics (CRMA), and related commercial technologies

**Key Responsibilities**
* Salesforce Administration \& Platform Support

**Business Analysis \& Solution Delivery**

* Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, process reviews, and stakeholder interviews.
* Document business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement.
* Collaborate with CRM Architects, Developers, Product Owners, and external partners to design and implement solutions.
* Support and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and validation of business requirements.


**Commercial Operations Support**
* Support CRM capabilities related to customer engagement, territory management, call reporting, targeting, account planning, and field force effectiveness.
* Partner with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Medical Affairs, and Marketing teams to optimize CRM processes and user experience.
* Support omnichannel engagement initiatives and HCP/HCO engagement activities.
* Assist in evaluating and prioritizing CRM enhancements aligned with business priorities.


**Reporting, Analytics \& Data Management**
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics supporting business and leadership decision\-making.
* Support CRM data governance, quality monitoring, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Perform data mapping, transformation, migration, and validation activities during system enhancements and implementation projects.
* Partner with Data \& Analytics teams to support Customer 360, reporting, and data management initiatives.


**Integrations \& Ecosystem Support**
* Support integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms including IQVIA, Pitcher, Data Cloud, Snowflake, Marketing technologies, MDM, and reporting solutions.
* Assist with troubleshooting integration issues and validating end\-to\-end business processes.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure successful delivery of integrated solutions across the CRM ecosystem.


**Training, Adoption \& Governance**
* Develop and deliver end\-user training, documentation, job aids, and adoption materials.
* Support change management and user adoption initiatives to maximize business value from CRM investments.
* Participate in CRM governance processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure solutions and business processes align with pharmaceutical industry compliance requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, and applicable regulatory standards.


**Qualifications**
* 7\-10\+ years of experience supporting Salesforce CRM platforms with hands\-on Salesforce Administration and Business Analysis responsibilities.
* Salesforce Administrator Certification required. Also Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Salesforce Business Analyst, Sales Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Consultant, or Life Sciences Cloud certifications.
* Strong experience supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud, Veeva, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics (CRMA), Experience Cloud, or similar CRM technologies.

* Experience supporting pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.

* Experience working with CRM integrations, data management, and reporting solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile delivery and cross\-functional team environments

Required Skills: \- Strong understanding of CASA products, including current and savings accounts. \- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with clients. \- Ability to work independently and as part of a team. \- Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. \- Proficiency in using banking software and tools. If you are passionate about banking and customer service, and you have the skills to drive business growth, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Partner Success Manager
description:

 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 India
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **Partner Success Manager** 
 is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre\-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Develop and manage role\-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.

* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.

* 5\+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.

* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi\-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co\-sell models.

 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

title: Customer Success, Staff
description:
Job Posting Description
   

  

 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for the overall engagement, success, and retention of assigned customer accounts. Acting as both the internal advocate for the client and the external representative of Blackbaud, the CSM ensures that client objectives are met by fostering trusted relationships and strategic communication. This role also involves collaborating cross\-departmentally to address client needs, identify opportunities for growth, and support client goals with innovative solutions. This individual contributor role is responsible for driving the adoption and success of Blackbaud’s platform, ensuring client satisfaction, and accountability for revenue growth and retention.
   

  

**Work Location \& Schedule**
**Work Location:** 
 Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Work Schedule**
* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Ability to work a schedule aligned with U.S. business hours, generally 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), with availability for customer\-facing engagements during that time.
* Participation in after\-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.


**What You’ll Do (Job Duties And Responsibilities)**
* Drive Platform Adoption and Retention: Serve as the strategic leader for assigned accounts, ensuring the successful adoption and use of Blackbaud products to achieve client business objectives and promote client retention.
* Develop Customer Success Plans: Work collaboratively with clients to build comprehensive success plans that outline critical goals and the strategies to achieve them.
* Strategic Communication: Establish a proactive communication cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to client needs, and facilitate meetings that review progress, share key insights, and align on next steps.
* Trusted Customer Advocate: Cement yourself as a trusted advisor, leveraging empathy, critical thinking, and active listening to understand client needs and provide tailored solutions.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Product, Operations, and Support to resolve issues, manage escalations, and communicate client feedback that informs product development and process improvements.
* Monitor Key Performance Metrics: Track and report client achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs), providing insights both internally and to customer stakeholders.
* Support and Training Identification: Work with the Training team to identify additional client training opportunities that enhance product knowledge and usage.
* Champion the Customer’s Voice: Serve as the customer’s advocate, raising up key insights and feedback from customers to the internal Blackbaud organization.
* Continuous Learning and Adaptation: Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Blackbaud's current and upcoming product offerings and incorporate feedback to enhance customer engagements.


  

  

**What You’ll Bring (Job Requirements)**
* Technical Proficiency: Adept at engaging in consultative technical discussions and providing light technical solutions. Experience with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) and CSPs (e.g., Gainsight) is advantageous.
* Exceptional Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to handle strategic conversations and deliver concise, respectful, and value\-driven messaging.
* Customer\-Centric Approach: Demonstrated ability to understand customer needs, anticipate challenges, and respond with urgency to deliver exceptional service.
* Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Ability to analyze complex problems, think logically, and make sound business decisions that benefit both Blackbaud and the customer.
* Organization and Time Management: Proven skills in managing multiple projects and priorities, meeting deadlines, and maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Team Collaboration and Emotional Intelligence: Strong interpersonal skills, showing empathy, tact, and diplomacy in managing client relationships and supporting colleagues.
* Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with a proactive attitude to adapt to evolving client and business needs.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: Experience leveraging analytics, reports, and trends to measure success, improve client outcomes, and enhance product usage.
* Self\-Motivation and Learning: Demonstrated desire to grow professionally, pursue continuous learning, and set personal goals that align with team success.


**Core Competencies**
* Active listening, empathy, and ability to create positive and impactful client experiences.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities, independent decision\-making, and confidence in judgment.
* Proficiency in aligning work with company objectives and understanding the impact of individual actions on business metrics.
* Proactive communication with an emphasis on building trust, managing expectations, and maintaining accountability.
* Effective collaboration with a focus on teamwork, supporting others, and contributing to the collective success of the team.
* Ownership and responsibility in delivering quality work and addressing issues constructively.
* Advanced level English


 Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube
   

  

 Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our
 *Intelligence for Good®* 
 vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.
   

  

 Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Manager - Customer Service Transformation and AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Senior Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Lead end\-to\-end CCaaS and Customer Service AI transformation programs that align with client vision and business objectives—enhancing contact center capabilities with cloud\-native platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9\), conversational AI, CX insights, and operating model redesign. Serve as both growth driver and delivery anchor, working with C‑suite stakeholders, platform partners, and internal teams to deliver measurable impact.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Growth**
* Advise C\-suite stakeholders on customer service transformation strategies, including AI adoption, digital channels, and experience\-led service design.
* Define target operating models, business cases, and transformation roadmaps aligned to enterprise priorities.
* Identify value levers across cost reduction, experience improvement, and automation.
* Lead pursuits: RFP responses, solution proposals, pricing, and executive stakeholder engagements.
* Build practice offerings in collaboration with CCaaS and AI platform partners to differentiate service capabilities.


**End\-to\-End Delivery**
* Drive full lifecycle delivery for global, multi\-stream of customer service, CCaaS and AI transformation programs: discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Implement Agile project management with on‑shore/off‑shore delivery teams and robust governance.


**Technology \& Innovation Enablement**
* Guide clients on CCaaS platform selection, architecture, and implementation (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9\).
* Drive adoption of conversational AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance service quality and efficiency.
* Bridge business and technology teams to ensure solutions are scalable and outcome\-driven.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain senior\-level client relationships, acting as a strategic partner and trusted advisor.
* Communicate complex transformation initiatives clearly to executive audiences.
* Identify and cultivate follow\-on opportunities within existing accounts.


**Market \& Technology Insight**
* Monitor emerging CCaaS, conversational AI, and CX trends to inform strategy and innovation.
* Team Leadership
* Build, mentor, and lead cross\-functional consulting teams and delivery teams.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Agile delivery and on‑shore/off‑shore team coordination.
* Strong stakeholder management across client and vendor teams.
* Conversational AI experience (bots, IVA, NLP) and platform migration expertise.
* Data compliance knowledge (PCI/PII, GDPR) tied to CCaaS and compliance platforms.
* Win and deliver multiple CCaaS transformation programs, meeting scope, budget, and timeline goals.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer service KPIs: AHT, FCR, CSAT/NPS.
* Expand practice pipeline through partner GTM initiatives and follow\-on client engagements.
* Build a high‑performing team and enhance practice capabilities via PoVs, thought leadership, and accelerators.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate expertise in customer contact center technologies through certifications from leading CCaaS providers, including AWS, Genesys, NICE, and Five9\.
* Have experience designing or implementing integrations between contact center platforms and enterprise CRM solutions such as Salesforce Service Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics 365\.


**What We Look For**
* 8–12\+ years in customer service and contact center transformation or consulting, with at least 5 years in CCaaS or cloud contact center delivery.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large\-scale CCaaS transformations across discovery, migration, and managed operations.
* Experience in proposal writing, executive presentations, and business development within service operations or contact center technology.
* Hands\-on knowledge of CCaaS platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Five9\) and integrations with CRM systems.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Support Manager
description:

 Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
   

  

 Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive\-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
   

  

 They will also have strong experience managing a high\-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

 Live classes, recorded modules, test series, mock tests, 24x7 doubt solving and mentoring, built around measurable student results.

 A community of millions of registered learners, with a large base of premium subscribers across India.

 The credibility, faculty depth and school network of the Sri Chaitanya Group behind every product.

 Learning programmes for schools alongside JEE, NEET and CBSE preparation, and acquisitions such as WizKlub in the cognitive\-skills space.

 As a
 **Regional Manager – School Success** 
 , you will lead renewals and revenue farming for key school accounts across multiple territories under Infinity Schools. You will manage complex stakeholder relationships, drive collections, and unlock expansion opportunities, helping partner schools get consistent, measurable value from Infinity Learn’s programmes. You may also mentor one or more Area Managers – School Success, depending on territory structure.

* **Strategic renewals:** 
 Own and drive renewals for multi\-school and high\-value accounts.

 Lead the strategy across Infinity Learn products, grades and learner categories.
* **Collections:** 
 Ensure collections are in line with renewal terms.
* **Escalations and leadership relationships:** 
 Handle escalations and build strong relationships with senior school leadership (Management, Principals, Directors).

 Work closely with PSMs so that service quality supports renewal conversions.

 Coach and support Area Managers – School Success in assigned geographies.

 Share weekly forecasts, renewal funnel progress and business risks with Zonal Managers.

* 6–10 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success or renewals.
* Prior experience managing K–12 or EdTech partnerships preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.
* Comfortable with extensive travel across the assigned region.



  





**KEY SKILLS \& TRAITS** 



* Strategic thinking and revenue ownership.
* High comfort with senior\-level school stakeholder engagement.
* Strong mentoring and team alignment abilities.
* Ability to collaborate across functions with urgency.



  





**WHY JOIN INFINITY LEARN** 



* **Legacy meets innovation:** 
 Work with the Sri Chaitanya brand while building in a fast\-moving EdTech environment.
* **Ownership:** 
 Real revenue responsibility across multi\-school accounts and territories.
* **Leadership growth:** 
 Opportunity to mentor and build a team as the school vertical scales.
* **Cross\-functional exposure:** 
 Partner with service, academic and sales teams to shape the school experience.
* **Purpose:** 
 Contribute to better learning outcomes for students across India.

title: Community Manager
description:
**Designation:** 
 Community Manager
 



**Reporting To:** 
 General Manager
 



**Functional Reporting:** 
 Assistant Director – Community
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Community Manager is the primary owner of the member experience at the club. This role leads day\-to\-day community operations, member engagement, renewals execution, and onboarding delivery, while coordinating closely with internal teams to ensure consistent service standards across all member touchpoints.
 



  





 This is an execution\-led role. While supported by Corporate Community for structure, tracking, and guidance, the Community Manager owns on\-ground delivery, real\-time decision\-making, and outcomes at the unit.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 









***1\. Member Engagement \& Relationships***




* Own member engagement at the unit, ensuring members feel recognised, welcomed, and valued at all times.
* Act as the face of the Community team on the floor, building strong relationships through regular interaction and personalised engagement.
* Maintain accurate member profiles, preferences, and interaction notes to enable personalised experiences.
* Address member concerns with empathy and discretion; resolve issues promptly or escalate when required.
* Track and share engagement insights, feedback trends, and key member inputs with leadership teams.








***2\. New Member Onboarding (On\-Ground Delivery)***




* Execute the new member onboarding experience at the unit, ensuring warm introductions and smooth integration.
* Coordinate with Membership Sales for structured handovers post\-sale.
* Ensure new members are oriented to the space, offerings, and community culture.
* Collect early\-stage feedback and act on gaps in the onboarding experience.
* Ensure onboarding steps are completed and tracked as per defined process.








***3\. Club Floor \& Community Operations***




* Own daily Community operations on the club floor, ensuring smooth functioning and high service standards.
* Actively manage the member journey from arrival to departure.
* Coordinate closely with F\&B Service, Culinary, Operations, and Facilities teams to deliver seamless hospitality.
* Identify operational gaps, log issues, and drive resolution at the unit level.
* Ensure adherence to Community SOPs and service frameworks on the floor.








***4\. Private Hires, Events \& Reservations***




* Act as the unit coordination point for private hires, member events, and reservations.
* Redirect and align enquiries with Sales and Operations teams as per defined process.
* Ensure accurate communication of event requirements and flawless on\-ground execution.
* Be the primary on\-site contact for members during events.








***5\. Team Coordination \& Communication***




* Lead and guide the unit Community team in daily priorities, service standards, and member handling.
* Coordinate internal communication across departments for member\-related requirements.
* Share updates, challenges, and best practices with Corporate Community and leadership teams.
* Support training, process adherence, and continuous improvement initiatives at the unit level.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 



* 5–8 years of experience in hospitality, community management, guest services, or customer experience roles.
* Strong on\-ground operational experience in premium or member\-led environments.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with high emotional intelligence.
* Ability to manage pressure situations calmly and professionally.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

title: VP - Employee Workplace Solutions Management
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Description**
**In this role, the candidate will manage the following**
* To drive the strategy of IWPB Employee Banking Solutions for the allocated market
* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14\-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)
* To ensure that the quality of the corporates acquired are in line with the strategic focus of the Bank
* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X \& PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions \& lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets


**Key activities to be driven**
* Work closely with both the GB/CMB RMs and MSF Business Development Managers (BDM) to engage with key decision makers of target corporates. Actively participate in presenting the HSBC EBS proposition with the objective to empanel them for the salary proposition
* Increase penetration of the corporates employee salary accounts with HSBC in the desired customer segments (Premier, personal Bankers)
* Make corporate work site marketing activities/deployments (WSMs) more interactive and effective
* Drive the overall asset strategy of WPB within the corporate space by identifying under penetrated opportunity segments, showcasing HSBCs offering and driving growth.
* Consistent delivery of the operating plan across all key products like EBS, Personal Banking accounts, PIL Cards, Premier Accounts)
* Controlling/lowering cost of acquisition within mandated cost guidelines
* Optimizing sourcing mix to focus on profitable segments in corporates
* Ensure minimal documentation errors (KYC) by driving the Right First Time behaviour across the team


 We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced professional to join our team.
   

  

**Requirements**
 To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
   

  

* University level education, preferably a MBA with 10 \-15 years of experience in banking.
* Front line sales experience is must in onboarding Salary Accounts, Personal Loans, Cards will be preferred.
* Good relationship management skills in order to engage effectively with both corporates and customers.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-disciplined with the ability to work effectively and independently


**Pro\-tip :** 
 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
   

  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
